patch.description:
只修改请求中出现的字段，其余配置保持不变。
支持名称、描述、运行模式、系统提示词、对话模型、知识库、MCP、技能范围、联网搜索、多轮对话。
agent_mode 取 quick-answer 或 smart-reasoning。MCP 与技能只在 smart-reasoning 下运行，切到该模式会打开多轮对话。
传 knowledge_bases、mcp_services 或 selected_skills 而不传对应模式时，切换为 selected。
技能模式 all/none 清空技能列表；启用技能须先在编辑器选择沙箱，selected 名称须可用，否则返回 400。
patch.x-agent-hint: Changes the listed settings of an agent; a field left out is kept. agent_mode is quick-answer or smart-reasoning; MCP services and skills only run in smart-reasoning, and switching to it turns multi-turn on. system_prompt replaces the whole prompt, so start from the full prompt agent.get returns. Take model_id from model.list (a KnowledgeQA model), knowledge base ids from knowledge_base.list and MCP service ids from mcp_service.list. Take web_search_provider_id from web_search_provider.list; an empty value follows the workspace default, and selecting a provider does not change web_search_enabled. Take skill names exactly from skill.list with the agent's sandbox_config_id. knowledge_base_ids, mcp_service_ids or selected_skills alone also switch that scope to selected.

default_tools.description: DefaultTools apply when an agent's allowed_tools was never set (null).

switch_managed_tools.description:
SwitchManagedTools follow other agent settings; naming them in the list
does not register them.

tools.description: Tools are the selectable tools, in display order.

danger.description: Danger marks tools that modify content, which the editor highlights.

model_thinking_levels.description:
ModelThinkingLevels lists, per chat model id, the levels offered once
thinking is enabled, resolved against the vendor map and protocol so
the console does not re-implement level inheritance.

vendor_thinking_levels.description: VendorThinkingLevels is what a chat model without its own map offers.

updated_at.description:
UpdatedAt is set only for the caller's own value; a workspace value has
no per-variable timestamp to report.

unverifiable.description:
Unverifiable reports that SandboxCount is unknown rather than zero
because the provider could not be reached. The management page must say
so instead of rendering a reassuring "0 sandboxes".

user_sandbox_count.description:
UserSandboxCount is how many of SandboxCount are shared user machines.
They carry no session id, so SessionIDs alone under-reports what a
credential change would affect.

served.description:
Served is set while a newer install of this skill is in flight or has
failed and the image still runs the previous version.

installed_on.description: InstalledOn lists the sandbox config ids of Installations.

target_slug.description:
TargetSlug identifies the other page involved in the issue (e.g. the
broken link target, or the entity slug for a missing cross-ref). It is
the structured field used by AutoFix instead of parsing Description.

fallback.description: Fallback 合并了固定回复模板和模型兜底 prompt（通过 mode:"model" 区分）

generate_kb_description.description: GenerateKBDescription writes the knowledge-base gist from the document profile aggregate.

intent_prompts.description: IntentPrompts holds per-intent system prompt overrides (template ID = intent value).

rewrite.description: Rewrite 合并了前端可选模板和运行时默认模板，每个模板同时包含 content + user

planned.description:
Planned marks a declared-but-unimplemented connector. The UI must show it
as unavailable rather than letting an operator configure a source whose
every operation returns "not implemented" (V3.0 §3.3 business systems).

priority.description: Priority order for UI display (lower = higher priority)

credentials.description:
Single logical credential field — DataSource credentials are a
per-connector atomic map, so "configured?" applies to the whole set.

catalog.description:
Catalog is the persisted tool-directory summary for list cards.
Omitted when this principal has never synchronized the service.

credentials.description:
Credentials is the per-field "configured?" map. Embedded on the main
response so the credential UI doesn't need a follow-up GET. The
frontend never sees the actual secret value — only whether one is
stored. Omitted entirely for builtin services (they can't have
per-tenant credentials).

base_url.description:
BaseURL is empty for callers who may not view integration detail, and
for builtin models; see NewModelResponse.

capabilities.description:
Capabilities is the catalog view of the model. Chat models get the
protocol, thinking levels and context window; embedding and rerank
models get input modalities, including support for image input.

credentials.description:
Per-field "configured?" map. Omitted for builtin models unless the
caller is a system administrator. See MCPServiceResponse.Credentials.

aliases.description:
Aliases are additional ids that resolve to this entry (dated
snapshots, vendor-prefixed names on gateways).

compat.description:
Compat is the protocol-specific overlay for this model (flat object,
fields depend on API). Decoded lazily by Resolve.

deprecated.description: Deprecated hides the entry from pickers but keeps resolution working.

dimension.description: Dimension is the embedding vector width (embedding entries only).

input.description: Input lists accepted modalities: text, image, audio, video.

reasoning.description: Reasoning reports whether the model can emit thinking at all.

source.description: Source is the documentation URL the facts were taken from.

thinking_levels.description:
ThinkingLevels maps protocol-neutral levels to vendor values; missing
keys inherit the vendor map. See api.ThinkingLevelMap.

type.description:
Type is the WeKnora model type this entry describes. Chat models with
image input are still KnowledgeQA; the UI derives VLM eligibility from
Input. Embedding / Rerank / ASR entries exist for the model picker.

hint.description: Hint is rendered under the input, for a warning the label cannot carry.

model_types.description: ModelTypes restricts the override; empty means every type.

required.description:
Required marks the credential mandatory even where the generic label
calls it optional.

model_types.description: ModelTypes restricts the field to some model types; empty means all.

placeholders.description: Placeholders carries localized variants of Placeholder.

secret.description: Secret marks values that must never be echoed back to the UI.

enabled.description: Enabled turns speech transcription on. Also send asr_model_id.

language.description: Language is an optional hint for transcription, such as zh or en.

model_id.description: Model that transcribes audio. model.list returns the ids.

approvals.description:
Approvals is the user decision for tools in this step. It is stored with
the step so a reloaded transcript can show what was allowed or refused.

background_injections.description:
BackgroundInjections are background-work messages delivered before this
model response, after the step's steered messages, in delivery order.

background_seen_ids.description:
BackgroundSeenIDs are finished background items whose results this
step's tool calls (work_wait, work_cancel) returned to the model.

intermediate_answer.description:
IntermediateAnswer preserves a plain answer followed by a loop-end steer.
The canonical final answer is still stored in Message.Content.

progress.description: Progress is user-facing commentary from a non-terminal round. Thought stays intact for model replay.

reasoning_content.description:
ReasoningContent stores the OpenAI-protocol reasoning_content emitted by the
model in this round. Persisted on AgentStep so cross-turn replay can put it
back on the assistant message — required by MiMo / DeepSeek V3.2+ thinking
mode, ignored by providers that don't recognize the field.

reasoning_signature.description:
ReasoningSignature / ReasoningMetadata are the provider artifacts that
must accompany ReasoningContent on replay (Anthropic signatures,
OpenAI Responses encrypted reasoning items).

tool_calls.description: Tools called in this step (Act phase)

truncated.description:
Truncated marks the round the completion-token cap cut off. It rides in
the agent_steps JSON so a reloaded, shared or re-opened conversation can
still show that the answer stops mid-sentence by design, rather than
looking finished. Live streaming carries the same fact on the answer
event; this is what survives the round trip.

user_messages_before.description:
UserMessagesBefore records consumed steer rows in delivery order, before
this model response. Unlike timestamps, this remains unambiguous on replay.

all_of.description: AllOf: KB must expose ALL of these capability flags.

any_of.description: AnyOf: KB must expose at least ONE of these capability flags.

none_of.description: NoneOf: KB must expose NONE of these capability flags.

kb_selection_mode.description:
KBSelectionMode presets the KB picker mode: "all" | "selected" | "none".
When empty, the user's current value stays untouched.

display_name.description:
DisplayName replaces the product name in the assistant UI; empty keeps
the default.

max_access_level.description:
MaxAccessLevel is the highest level a member may pick; empty means
AssistantAccessConfirm.

consumers.description: downstream steps that read this attribute

description.description: one line explaining what the attribute measures

inject.description:
Inject says whether this attribute is always part of the describe round's
standing questions, or only asked when something is going to act on it.
An empty value means AttrInjectAlways, so attributes registered before
this field existed keep their behaviour.

internal.description:
Internal marks an attribute that steers this pipeline's own scheduling
rather than describing what the image holds. Such attributes are still
observed and persisted — the values are what justify a scheduling
decision after the fact — but they are kept out of the gallery's filter
surface, where they would only add noise: no operator wants to filter a
library by "how much margin is left around the text".

label.description: human-readable name for the settings panel

question.description: sentence shown to the model in the describe round

prev_hash.description:
PrevHash is the row_hash of the previous entry of the same tenant
(empty for the genesis row). Written by the repository inside the
insert transaction; callers must not set it (KnowAxis V3.0 §6.7).

row_hash.description:
RowHash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical fields). Unique per row; makes
the per-tenant audit stream tamper-evident (append-only + hash chain).

enabled.description: Enabled turns automatic tagging on. The model picks from tags that already exist.

max_tags.description: MaxTags is how many tags one document may receive, from 1 to 10.

model_id.description: ModelID overrides the summary model. Empty uses summary_model_id.

skip_if_tagged.description: SkipIfTagged leaves a document alone when it already has tags. Empty means yes.

access_level.description:
AccessLevel is how far runs may change data without asking, capped by
the workspace's assistant ceiling.

active_run_status.description: ActiveRunStatus is projected from live runs and is not persisted.

approval_timeout_minutes.description:
ApprovalTimeoutMinutes is how long a run waits for an approval before
it fails.

carry_last_result.description:
CarryLastResult adds the last successful answer to each per-run
conversation.

instruction.description:
Instruction is the task, sent as the user message of each run after
its variables are filled in.

model_id.description: ModelID overrides the assistant's chat model; empty follows the assistant default.

owner_user_id.description: OwnerUserID is the account the automation runs as.

persistent_session_id.description:
PersistentSessionID is the conversation of a persistent automation,
created on its first run.

max_duration_minutes.description:
MaxDurationMinutes caps a run's execution time, not counting time spent
waiting for approval. 0 uses the default.

access_level.description: How far runs may change data without asking

approval_timeout_minutes.description: How long a run waits for an approval before it fails, in minutes

carry_last_result.description: Whether each per_run conversation gets the last successful answer

enabled.description: Whether it is scheduled; on update use pause and resume instead

instruction.description:
The task, sent as the user message of each run. May name now,
last_run_at, last_success_at, run_id or automation_name inside double
curly braces to have it filled in

misfire_policy.description: What happens to runs missed while the service was down or paused

model_id.description: Optional chat model from model.list; empty follows the assistant default

notify_on_success.description: Whether a successful run notifies the owner

overlap_policy.description: What happens when a run is due while the previous one is still going

session_mode.description: per_run starts a new conversation each run; persistent keeps one

answer.description: Answer is the start of the final answer, for listings.

cancel_requested.description: CancelRequested stops the run at its next check.

pending_prompt_id.description: PendingPromptID is the approval a waiting run is suspended on.

scheduled_at.description:
ScheduledAt is when the run was due; for a manual run, when it was
asked for.

user_message_id.description: UserMessageID and AssistantMessageID are the run's turn in SessionID.

at.description:
At is when a once trigger fires, RFC3339 or a wall-clock time in
Timezone, such as "2006-01-02T15:04:05" or "2006-01-02 15:04".

expr.description:
Expr is a cron expression: five fields (minute first) or six (seconds
first), or a descriptor such as @daily.

timezone.description: Timezone is an IANA zone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai; empty means UTC.

key.description: Key 机器可读的条件键（如 "verify_sample_qa"）。

embedding_model_id.description:
EmbeddingModelID is the ID of the embedding model used for vectorizing chat messages.
Once messages have been indexed, the model cannot be changed (requires re-indexing).

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether chat history indexing is active

knowledge_base_id.description:
KnowledgeBaseID is the auto-managed hidden knowledge base for chat history.
This is set internally when the feature is first enabled; users should not set this directly.

embedding_model_id.description: ID of the embedding model used

enabled.description: Whether the chat history KB is configured and enabled

has_indexed_messages.description: Whether there are any indexed messages (used by frontend to lock embedding model)

indexed_message_count.description: Number of indexed message entries (Knowledge count)

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of the knowledge base used for chat history

citation_enabled.description:
CitationEnabled controls only final knowledge/web source citations. Nil
defaults to true for requests and agents created before this option existed.

disable_vector_match.description:
DisableVectorMatch / DisableKeywordsMatch turn off one recall path for
every search target. Set by the knowledge-search API.

parent_slot_aggregation.description:
ParentSlotAggregation collapses hits that share a ParentChunkID into one
top-k slot, so sibling children of the same parent cannot crowd out other
pages. Set by the knowledge-search API; off by default.

prompt_version.description:
PromptVersionTag is the "<template>@v<n>" tag of the tenant prompt version
that produced this answer (§16.5). Empty means the built-in template.

query_understand_model_id.description:
QueryUnderstandModelID, when set, overrides the chat model used for
the query-understanding (rewrite + intent classification) stage only.
Empty means fall back to ChatModelID.

refusal_marker.description:
RefusalMarker records which §13.5 refusal case this turn hit (empty when
the answer is normal). Written to the Evidence Pack so an audit can tell
"refused because every source was expired" from "answered normally".

refusal_notice.description:
RefusalNotice is the caveat appended to an answer that is allowed but
qualified (stale-only evidence, or a high-risk question without an
official source).

chunk_index.description: Index position of the chunk in the original document

chunk_type.description: Chunk 类型，用于区分不同类型的 Chunk

content.description: Actual text content of the chunk

content_hash.description: ContentHash 存储内容的 hash 值，用于快速匹配（主要用于 FAQ）

content_revision.description: ContentRevision is incremented for every user edit or rollback.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker, supports data recovery

end_at.description: Ending character position in the original text

flags.description:
Flags 存储多个布尔状态的位标志（如推荐状态等）
默认值为 ChunkFlagRecommended (1)，表示默认可推荐

id.description: Unique identifier of the chunk, using UUID format

index_status.description:
IndexStatus reports whether the current content is reflected in the
retrieval stores: ready | processing | failed.

indirect_relation_chunks.description: 间接关系 Chunk ID，用于关联间接关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

is_enabled.description: Whether the chunk is enabled, can be used to temporarily disable certain chunks

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of the knowledge base, for quick location

knowledge_id.description: ID of the parent knowledge, associated with the Knowledge model

last_editor_id.description: LastEditorID records the actor that produced the current revision.

metadata.description: Metadata 存储 chunk 级别的扩展信息，例如 FAQ 元数据

parent_chunk_id.description: 父 Chunk ID，用于关联图片 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

relation_chunks.description: 关系 Chunk ID，用于关联关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

seq_id.description: SeqID is an auto-increment integer ID for external API usage (FAQ entries)

source_locators.description:
SourceLocators point back into the original file (page and region,
slide, sheet rows, ...) so citations can open the file at this chunk.
Empty when the parser reported no positions.

start_at.description: Starting character position in the original text

tag_id.description: Optional tag ID for categorization within a knowledge base (used for FAQ)

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID, used for multi-tenant isolation

child_chunk_size.description:
ChildChunkSize is the size of child chunks used for embedding (default: 384).
Only used when EnableParentChild is true.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in characters. Empty on create uses the server default.

enable_parent_child.description:
EnableParentChild splits into large parent chunks and small child chunks.
Search matches a child and returns its parent.

languages.description: Languages hints the splitter, for example de or zh. Empty detects the language from the document.

parent_chunk_size.description:
ParentChunkSize is the size of parent chunks (default: 4096).
Only used when EnableParentChild is true.

parser_engine_rules.description:
ParserEngineRules configures which parser engine to use for each file type.
When empty, DefaultParserEngine is used (builtin/simple routing, except
types that only a specific engine can parse: ppt/pptx fall back to
markitdown). A linked anydoc binding is preferred for every type it
converts.

separators.description: Separators, in the order they are tried.

strategy.description:
Strategy selects how documents are split: auto, heading, heuristic,
recursive or legacy. Empty keeps the server default.

table_metadata_instructions.description: TableMetadataInstructions is extra guidance for CSV and Excel summaries. The output format stays fixed.

token_limit.description: TokenLimit caps chunk size in approximate tokens. 0 uses ChunkSize as a character count.

database.description:
Database name used by engines that support database-level namespaces
(currently Milvus, Tencent VectorDB, and Doris).

http_port.description:
Doris: HTTP port for Stream Load API (FE default 8030).
Addr is reused for the MySQL protocol "host:9030"; HTTPPort + the host of Addr
together form the FE HTTP endpoint used by Stream Load.

insecure_skip_verify.description:
InsecureSkipVerify disables TLS certificate verification when
talking to the backing store over HTTPS. Defaults to false
(secure). Set to true ONLY for self-signed development clusters;
production deployments should provide trusted certificates via
the system CA pool. Cross-driver applicable but currently only
the OpenSearch driver (Phase 3) reads this field. Note: this
differs from the Qdrant-specific UseTLS below, which *enables*
TLS on gRPC connections — InsecureSkipVerify only controls
*verification* of an already-TLS connection.

version.description:
Version is the detected server version (e.g., "7.10.1", "16.2", "1.12.6").
Auto-populated by TestConnection on successful connectivity check.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens allowed in LLM context

recent_message_count.description:
For sliding_window: number of messages to keep
For smart: number of recent messages to keep uncompressed

summarize_threshold.description: Summarize threshold: number of messages before summarization

audit.description: Audit is none | metadata | full. Empty uses the server default.

deny.description:
Deny inverts the action, which defaults to allow. A deny rule still
needs Host or SNI: the target has to reach CubeEgress for it to answer
with a request-level 403 instead of the network layer dropping it.

inject.description: Inject adds credential headers on allowed HTTPS requests.

dns_servers.description: DNSServers are Cube template nameserver IPs. Empty uses Cubelet's default.

http_timeout_sec.description:
HTTPTimeoutSec bounds each HTTP call to the sandbox control plane.
0 means use the built-in default (30s), never the deployment's value.

avatar.description: Avatar/Icon of the agent (emoji or icon name)

creator_name.description:
CreatorName 由 list handler 在返回前批量回填，作用同 KnowledgeBase.CreatorName：
让前端列表卡片区分「我创建」与「同空间其他成员创建」。不落库，内建 agent / 老数据
仍可能为空。

id.description:
Unique identifier of the agent (composite primary key with TenantID)
For built-in agents, this is 'builtin-quick-answer' or 'builtin-smart-reasoning'
For custom agents, this is a UUID

is_builtin.description: Whether this is a built-in agent (normal mode / agent mode)

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID (composite primary key with ID)

access_level.description:
AccessLevel is the highest access level a run of this agent gets: how
far it may change data (MCP tools, Wiki writes) without asking. Empty
means auto_write. The WeKnora assistant uses the workspace's assistant
ceiling instead.

agent_mode.description:
===== Basic Settings =====
Agent mode: "quick-answer" for RAG mode, "smart-reasoning" for ReAct agent mode

agent_type.description:
AgentType is a preset category under smart-reasoning mode that pre-fills
system prompt, allowed tools and recommended KB compatibility.
Valid values: "rag-qa", "wiki-qa", "hybrid-rag-wiki", "custom".
Empty / unknown values are treated as "custom" (no preset applied).
Ignored for quick-answer mode.

asr_model_id.description: ASR model ID for audio transcription (optional)

attachment_image_understanding.description:
AttachmentImageUnderstanding enables VLM OCR fallback for image-only /
scanned documents (PDF/PPT whose pages are images). Disabled by default
because it materially increases parse latency; only triggers when the
extracted text is below a threshold and a VLM model is configured.

attachment_ocr_max_pages.description:
AttachmentOCRMaxPages caps how many pages of a scanned / image-only
document this agent sends to the VLM for OCR. 0 falls back to the global
default (WEKNORA_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_OCR_MAX_PAGES). More pages means higher
coverage but slower parsing and more VLM cost.

attachment_parse_wait_timeout_sec.description:
AttachmentParseWaitTimeoutSec bounds, in seconds, how long a chat turn
waits for this agent's still-parsing attachments before proceeding with
only the finished ones. 0 falls back to the global default
(WEKNORA_CHAT_ATTACHMENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC).

audio_upload_enabled.description: Whether audio upload (ASR transcription) is enabled for this agent (default: false)

chat_parser_engine_rules.description:
===== Chat Attachment Parsing Settings =====
ChatParserEngineRules selects parser engines for session-scoped chat
attachments by file type. Takes precedence over the tenant-level
ParserEngineConfig.ChatParserEngineRules; an explicit per-request
parser_engine still overrides both.

citation_enabled.description:
Whether final answers include knowledge/web source citations. Nil defaults to true
so agents saved before this option was introduced keep their existing behavior.

context_template.description: Context template for normal mode (how to format retrieved chunks)

context_template_id.description:
ContextTemplateID references a template ID in prompt_templates/ YAML files.
If set and ContextTemplate is empty, the template content is resolved at request time for saved agents.

data_analysis_enabled.description:
===== Data Analysis Settings =====
Whether to run the legacy in-pipeline DuckDB SQL data-analysis stage when
the retrieved chunks include CSV/Excel files. This issues an extra LLM
call to generate a SQL query and is disabled by default because most
quick-answer / RAG-style agents do not want the added latency.

embedding_top_k.description:
===== Retrieval Strategy Settings (for both modes) =====
Embedding/Vector retrieval top K

enable_query_expansion.description:
===== Advanced Settings (mainly for normal mode) =====
Whether to enable query expansion

enable_rewrite.description: Whether to enable query rewrite for multi-turn conversations

fallback_strategy.description: Fallback strategy: "fixed" for fixed response, "model" for model generation

faq_direct_answer_threshold.description: FAQ direct answer threshold - if similarity > this value, use FAQ answer directly

faq_priority_enabled.description:
===== FAQ Strategy Settings =====
Whether FAQ priority strategy is enabled (FAQ answers prioritized over document chunks)

faq_score_boost.description: FAQ score boost multiplier - FAQ results score multiplied by this factor

history_turns.description: Number of history turns to keep in context. Quick-answer only; smart-reasoning sizes history by context window

image_storage_provider.description:
Storage provider for image uploads: "local", "minio", "cos", "tos", "s3", "oss", "ks3".
Empty means use the global/workspace default provider.

image_upload_enabled.description:
===== Image Upload / Multimodal Settings =====
Whether image upload is enabled for this agent (default: false)

intent_prompts.description:
IntentPrompts holds per-intent system prompt overrides for non-retrieval
intents (greeting, chitchat, etc.). Empty values fall back to templates
under config/prompt_templates/intent_prompts.yaml.

kb_selection_mode.description:
===== Knowledge Base Settings =====
Knowledge base selection mode: "all" = all KBs, "selected" = specific KBs, "none" = no KB

knowledge_bases.description: Associated knowledge base IDs (only used when KBSelectionMode is "selected")

llm_call_timeout.description: Timeout for a single LLM call in seconds (0 = use global default)

max_completion_tokens.description:
Maximum completion tokens. Quick-answer uses this for the RAG answer.
Smart-reasoning ReAct rounds send this value as-is (zero becomes
DefaultMaxCompletionTokens at call time: 24576 for smart reasoning).

max_iterations.description:
===== Agent Mode Settings =====
Maximum iterations for the ReAct loop. Zero is unset (filled with a
default). A negative value is unlimited: the loop runs until the model
stops, the user cancels, or another guard fires.

mcp_auth_wait_timeout.description:
MCPAuthWaitTimeout is how many seconds to wait for in-conversation OAuth
authorization before skipping. <=0 uses the gate's configured timeout.

mcp_selection_mode.description: MCP service selection mode: "all" = all enabled MCP services, "selected" = specific services, "none" = no MCP

mcp_services.description: Selected MCP service IDs (only used when MCPSelectionMode is "selected")

memory_enabled.description:
Whether this agent may read the user's long-term memory. Nil inherits
the workspace setting; false opts a single agent out of memory even when
the workspace has it on. There is no "on" that overrides the workspace.

model_id.description:
===== Model Settings =====
Model ID to use for conversations

multi_turn_enabled.description:
===== Multi-turn Conversation Settings =====
Whether multi-turn conversation is enabled

query_understand_model_id.description:
Dedicated chat model ID for the query-understanding (rewrite + intent) step.
When empty, the main conversation ModelID is used as a fallback.

question_suggestions.description:
===== Conversation Question Suggestions =====
QuestionSuggestions owns both the static/knowledge-backed prompts shown
before the first user turn and the contextual follow-up questions shown
after a completed assistant answer.

reasoning_effort.description:
ReasoningEffort selects the thinking intensity (off | auto | minimal |
low | medium | high | xhigh | max). Empty keeps the boolean Thinking
semantics: true means "auto". See internal/models/api.ReasoningEffort.

retain_retrieval_history.description: Whether to retain retrieval history across turns

retrieve_kb_only_when_mentioned.description:
Whether to retrieve knowledge base only when explicitly mentioned with @ (default: false)
When true, knowledge base retrieval only happens if user explicitly mentions KB/files with @
When false, knowledge base retrieval happens according to KBSelectionMode

sandbox_config_id.description:
===== Sandbox Settings =====
SandboxConfigID selects which workspace sandbox config this agent's
skill scripts run on. Empty means sandbox execution is disabled.

This references the LOGICAL config, never a specific revision: keeping
the indirection here is what would let credential rotation happen
without re-pointing every agent (see the spec's §4.8).

selected_skills.description: Selected skill names (only used when SkillsSelectionMode is "selected")

skills_selection_mode.description:
===== Skills Settings (only for smart-reasoning mode) =====
Skills selection mode: "all" = all installed skills, "selected" = specific skills, "none" = no skills

supported_file_types.description:
===== File Type Restriction Settings =====
Supported file types for this agent (e.g., ["csv", "xlsx", "xls"])
Empty means all file types are supported
When set, only files with matching extensions can be used with this agent

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the agent (unified prompt, uses web_search_status placeholder for dynamic behavior)

system_prompt_id.description:
SystemPromptID references a template ID in prompt_templates/ YAML files.
If set and SystemPrompt is empty, the template content is resolved at request time for saved agents.

thinking.description: Whether to enable thinking mode (for models that support extended thinking)

vlm_model_id.description: VLM model ID for image analysis (optional, falls back to workspace-level VLM)

web_fetch_enabled.description: Whether to auto-fetch full page content for reranked web search results

web_fetch_top_n.description: Max number of pages to fetch after rerank (default: 3)

web_search_enabled.description:
===== Web Search Settings =====
Whether web search is enabled

web_search_provider_id.description:
WebSearchProviderID references a specific WebSearchProviderEntity.
If empty, the workspace's default provider (is_default=true) is used.

config.description:
Encrypted configuration (API credentials, tokens, etc.)
Stored as JSON with AES-256-GCM encryption

conflict_strategy.description: Conflict resolution strategy: overwrite or skip

last_sync_cursor.description: Cursor or state for incremental sync (connector-specific)

latest_sync_log.description: Latest sync log (not stored in DB, populated on query)

sync_deletions.description: Whether to sync deletions from source

sync_log_retention_days.description: Number of days to keep sync logs (default: 30)

sync_schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled syncs (e.g., "0 */6 * * *" = every 6 hours)

total_items_synced.description: Total items synced (not stored in DB, calculated on query)

asr_model_id.description: ASRModelID is the default ASR model.

chat_model_id.description: ChatModelID is the default KnowledgeQA model.

embedding_model_id.description: EmbeddingModelID is the default Embedding model.

rerank_model_id.description: RerankModelID is the default Rerank model.

utility_model_id.description:
UtilityModelID is the KnowledgeQA model for short generation tasks
such as writing MCP usage instructions. Empty follows the chat default.

vlm_model_id.description: VLMModelID is the default VLLM or vision-capable KnowledgeQA model.

cpu_limit.description:
CPULimit is the number of CPU cores one sandbox may use. 0 uses the
built-in default.

host.description:
Host is the daemon endpoint in DOCKER_HOST form. Empty means the local
unix socket.

http_timeout_sec.description: HTTPTimeoutSec bounds each Engine API call. 0 uses the built-in default.

idle_ttl_seconds.description:
IdleTTLSeconds is how long a session container may go unused before it
is reclaimed. The daemon has no idle timeout of its own, so this is what
stops an abandoned session from pinning host memory indefinitely.

memory_limit_mb.description: MemoryLimitMB caps one sandbox's memory. 0 uses the built-in default.

network_mode.description:
NetworkMode is the Docker network sandboxes join: "bridge" (default) or
"none" for no egress. Nothing else is accepted — host and container:
modes share another namespace outright, and a named network is usually
the deployment's own compose network, which would put the sandbox next
to Postgres and Redis.

pids_limit.description:
PidsLimit caps how many processes one sandbox may run. 0 uses the
built-in default.

runtime.description:
Runtime selects an alternative OCI runtime such as "runsc" (gVisor).
Empty uses the daemon default.

tls_cert_path.description:
TLSCertPath is a directory on the WeKnora host containing ca.pem,
cert.pem and key.pem. Required when Host is a TCP endpoint.

headers.description:
Headers values are credentials and are encrypted at rest; names stay
readable so operators can see which headers are injected.

http_timeout_sec.description:
HTTPTimeoutSec bounds each HTTP call to the sandbox control plane.
0 means use the built-in default (30s), never the deployment's value.

proxy_url.description:
ProxyURL is the data-plane gateway that fronts envd. E2B Cloud resolves
"<port>-<sandboxID>.<sandbox_domain>" through public DNS and TLS, so it
needs no value here. Self-hosted E2B-compatible control planes usually
serve every sandbox from one gateway address and expect the sandbox
authority in the Host header; setting this makes WeKnora dial the
gateway directly instead of requiring wildcard DNS and a certificate
for the sandbox domain. An "http://" gateway also downgrades the
data-plane scheme, which the E2B SDK otherwise pins to https.

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions adds domain guidance. The graph output format stays fixed.

enabled.description: Enabled turns graph extraction on. Node and relation types are edited in the knowledge base editor.

tags.description: Tags are the entity labels extraction may use.

text.description: Text is the extraction prompt. Required when extraction is on and no text is saved yet.

task_id.description: 可选，如果不传则自动生成UUID

matched_question.description:
MatchedQuestion is the actual question text that was matched in FAQ search
Could be the standard question or one of the similar questions

by_id.description: ByID 按条目ID更新，key为条目ID (seq_id)

exclude_ids.description: ExcludeIDs 在ByTag操作中需要排除的ID列表 (seq_id)

answer_strategy.description: all returns every answer; random returns one.

answers.description: Answers; one is picked by answer_strategy.

id.description: ID 可选，用于数据迁移时指定 seq_id（必须小于自增起始值 100000000）

is_enabled.description: Whether the entry is served; omit to keep the current or default value.

is_recommended.description: Whether the entry is recommended; omit to keep the current or default value.

negative_questions.description: Phrasings that must not match; [] for none.

similar_questions.description: Other phrasings that should match; [] for none.

tag_id.description: Tag seq id (tag_seq_id from knowledge_base.list_tags); 0 for none.

index.description: 条目在批次中的索引（从0开始）

is_partial_failure.description: 是否为部分失败（相似问/反例被移除，但整条仍可导入）

removed_similar_questions.description: 部分失败详情（当 IsPartialFailure 为 true 时）

dry_run.description: 是否为 dry run 模式

failed_entries.description: 失败条目详情（少量时直接返回）

failed_entries_url.description: 失败条目CSV下载URL（大量时返回URL）

merge_entry_indices.description: 需要合并的条目索引（内部使用，用于重试时跳过识别）

partial_failed_count.description: 部分失败的条目数（相似问/反例被移除）

skipped_count.description: 跳过的条目数（如重复等）

success_count.description: 完全成功的条目数（不包含部分成功/部分失败）

success_entries.description: 成功条目简单信息（少量时直接返回）

valid_entry_indices.description: 验证通过的条目索引（用于重试时跳过验证）

first_priority_tag_ids.description: 第一优先级标签ID列表，限定命中范围，优先级最高

only_recommended.description: 是否仅返回推荐的条目

second_priority_tag_ids.description: 第二优先级标签ID列表，限定命中范围，优先级低于第一优先级

index.description: 条目在批次中的索引（从0开始）

mode.description:
Mode is "all" (every search-eligible field active) or "custom"
(per-field Status governs). Empty = "all".

status.description:
Status maps a namespaced attribute id ("builtin:caption") to
"on"/"off". Only consulted in custom mode; an unrecorded field is
off. Source-declared on/off does not exist — activation is always
the user's own record.

knowledge_id.description: KnowledgeID 证据所在的知识条目。

locator.description: Locator 原文定位（SourceLocator 语义，可为空=只有 chunk 级溯源）。

quote.description: Quote 原文片段（LLM 输出的支撑引文）。

createAt.description: When this history entry was created

knowledgeReferences.description: Knowledge references used in the answer

attrs.description:
Attrs is the observed attribute map (e.g. contain.text, contain.data_visual)
produced by the attribute pipeline. Absent keys mean "not observed".

caption.description: Caption is the model-generated image description.

chunk_id.description:
ChunkID is the owning chunk (text chunk for embedded images, or the
image_ocr / image_caption chunk for dedicated image assets).

chunk_type.description:
ChunkType is the owning chunk's type; empty for images discovered on a
text (document) chunk. Helps the UI label the source.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is the owning chunk's creation time.

id.description: ID is stable and unique within a KB: "<chunkID>#<index-in-array>".

is_enabled.description: IsEnabled mirrors the owning chunk's enabled flag.

knowledge_id.description: KnowledgeID is the document/knowledge item the image belongs to.

ocr_text.description: OCRText is the extracted text from the image, if any.

original_url.description: OriginalURL is the pre-transform source reference, when different.

source_name.description:
SourceName is the human-readable name of the source knowledge item
(document), resolved from KnowledgeID. Empty when the item no longer
exists (e.g. deleted), in which case KnowledgeID is still shown.

status.description: Status mirrors the owning chunk's index status.

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is the owning chunk's last update time.

url.description: URL is the rendered image URL (COS / storage provider).

on.description:
On is the list of attribute conditions that enable OCR. Matching any one
turns OCR on.

image_actions.description:
ImageActions overrides the built-in attribute→work table (see
DefaultImageActions). A nil value keeps the conservative default: run OCR
for block text and data visuals. What to do about an image whose
attributes were NOT observed is deliberately not part of this table — it
is a scheduling decision, so it belongs to the pipeline that observes
(`ocr_on_unobserved` in that pipeline's slot).

image_attrs_enabled.description:
ImageAttrsEnabled turns the attribute-observed image pipeline on for this
knowledge base. It is off by default on purpose, so upgrading an
existing deployment never changes what happens to documents already
being ingested: with it off every image is described and OCR'd exactly
as before. When on, the describe round also observes image attributes and
the attribute policy decides whether OCR runs for it. A single upload can
override it per document through
KnowledgeProcessOverrides.ImageAttrsEnabled.

image_pipeline.description:
ImagePipelineID selects the image pipeline by id, so the choice the
settings panel offers is the choice the backend runs. It is unset on
knowledge bases configured before the field existed; those follow
ImageAttrsEnabled — see ResolveImagePipelineID. An explicit id always
wins over the switch.

image_pipeline_params.description:
ImagePipelineParams holds the tunables of ImagePipelineID, keyed by each
field's slot — the pipeline id joined to the field's own key, built by
SlotKey and read back by ImagePipelineParam. The map travels whole: a key
a pipeline no longer declares is dropped when the run reads it, so an old
stored config stays loadable rather than being rewritten on save.

image_vector_enabled.description:
ImageVectorEnabled lets a knowledge base whose embedding model takes
images index each image by its own vector and recall it with one. It
is off by default on purpose: a model that takes images is also used
for plain text, and turning this on costs an embedding call per image
and widens vector recall. Existing knowledge bases stay off after an
upgrade because the stored JSON has no such key.

model_id.description: Model ID used when describing images. Empty uses the knowledge base's caption model.

buckets_num.description: Doris: number of buckets per table (DISTRIBUTED BY HASH ... BUCKETS N)

desired_shard_count.description: Weaviate: number of shards per collection

hnsw_ef_construction.description: OpenSearch: HNSW index-build candidate list size

hnsw_ef_search.description: OpenSearch: HNSW search candidate list size (faiss; lucene reads at query time)

hnsw_m.description:
--- OpenSearch k-NN HNSW fields ---
All omitempty so other engines' serialized IndexConfig is unchanged.
Zero / empty values fall back to the driver defaults in buildInternalCfg.

replica_number.description: Milvus LoadCollection / Tencent VectorDB CreateCollection replicas

shards_num.description: Milvus: number of shards per collection (CreateCollection)

graph_enabled.description: GraphEnabled enables knowledge graph entity/relation extraction

vector_enabled.description: VectorEnabled enables semantic vector embedding and search

wiki_enabled.description: WikiEnabled enables automatic wiki page generation from documents

representative_user_id.description:
RepresentativeUserID is accepted for compatibility and ignored: a
direct add attaches no user of the enrolled workspace, since the
inviter must not choose whose details the roster shows.

tenant_id.description: TenantID is the workspace to enrol as an org member. Preferred field.

user_id.description:
UserID is retained for backward compatibility. When set without
TenantID, the handler resolves the user's TenantID.

faq.description: FAQ means the KB is a FAQ-type KB (Q/A pairs).

graph.description: Graph means knowledge-graph extraction is enabled.

keyword.description: Keyword means BM25 / sparse keyword search is indexed.

vector.description: Vector means semantic (embedding) search is indexed.

wiki.description: Wiki means the wiki feature is enabled and authored pages exist / will be generated.

channel.description: Channel indicates through which channel the knowledge was ingested (web, api, browser_extension, wechat, etc.)

classification.description:
Classification is the data sensitivity level (public/internal/secret/
confidential). Final visibility = classification allowance ∩ ACL.

current_version.description: CurrentVersion is the latest published version number.

custom_metadata.description:
CustomMetadata is user-authored descriptive metadata. It is deliberately
separate from Metadata, which contains internal ingestion state and IDs.

effective_at.description:
EffectiveAt marks when the entry becomes effective (pending_effective →
valid is evaluated lazily on read, never by a silent cron flip).

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt marks when the entry stops backing answers (read-time expiry).

folder_path.description:
FolderPath is the canonical relative directory this entry belongs to
inside the knowledge base, e.g. "docs/spec" for a folder upload of
"docs/spec/design.md". Empty means the knowledge base root. It is a
display/navigation concern only: it never affects where the file is
physically stored (see FilePath).

knowledge_base_name.description: Knowledge base name (not stored in database, populated on query)

last_activity_at.description:
Most recent processing progress (row or span write) for an in-flight
row, so clients can tell a slow stage from a stalled one. Not stored.

last_faq_import_result.description: Last FAQ import result (for FAQ type knowledge only)

last_reviewed_at.description:
LastReviewedAt / LastReviewedBy record the latest "confirmed valid"
review action, shown on the reading page as the verification badge.

lifecycle_status.description:
LifecycleStatus is the governance state of this knowledge entry
(KnowAxis V3.0 §7.1). It decides search/QA behaviour; legacy rows start
as "valid" so existing deployments keep working unchanged.

pending_subtasks_count.description:
PendingSubtasksCount is the outstanding enrichment subtask count
(summary + question + graph chunks). Only meaningful while
ParseStatus == "finalizing"; defaults to 0 in any terminal state.

profile.description:
Profile is the structured companion of Description: a one-line gist,
topic keywords, a document type and one typical question. It is produced
by the same model call as the summary and feeds the knowledge-base
level description aggregation. nil when no summary has been generated.

replaced_by_id.description: ReplacedByID points at the newer knowledge that replaced this entry.

review_cycle_days.description: ReviewCycleDays is the review cadence in days; 0 disables the cycle.

source.description: Source of the knowledge (e.g. URL address for url type, "manual" for manual type)

stall_state.description:
Verdict on an in-flight row gone quiet: StallStateQueued (its work is
still queued, i.e. backlogged) or StallStateStalled (nothing left to
run it). Empty while it is progressing or the probe failed. Not stored.

summary_status.description: Summary status for async summary generation

tags.description: Tags holds the tags associated with this knowledge (populated on query, not persisted directly).

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the knowledge

auto_tag_config.description: AutoTagConfig controls asynchronous association of existing tags after parsing.

chunk_count.description: Chunk count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

created_at.description: Creation time of the knowledge base

creator_id.description:
CreatorID records the user ID of whoever originally created the KB.
Used by the workspace-level RBAC middleware to let Contributors edit
their own KBs without granting them access to everyone else's.
Nullable for backward compatibility with rows created before the
RBAC migration backfilled the column to the workspace Owner.

creator_name.description:
CreatorName 是 CreatorID 对应用户的展示名（username / email 等），
仅在列表场景由 handler 批量回填，不落库；为空表示创建者无法解析（用户已删除、
CreatorID 为空的老数据等）。前端用它在卡片来源徽章上做 mine vs workspace 的二分。

default_classification.description:
DefaultClassification applies to new content without an explicit
classification (V3.0 §2.4 定密：无确认时按空间默认密级处理).

deleted_at.description: Deletion time of the knowledge base

embedding_model_id.description: ID of the embedding model. model.list returns the ids. Cannot change after the knowledge base has documents.

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt ends the space's life: project close or external NDA expiry
turns it read-only (§4.1).

faq_config.description: FAQConfig stores FAQ specific configuration such as indexing strategy

generated_profile.description:
GeneratedProfile is the machine-generated description: a gist, merged
topics, typical questions and the aggregate snapshot they came from. It
never overwrites the user-authored Description; both are shown to agents.

id.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base

indexing_strategy.description:
IndexingStrategy controls which indexing pipelines are active for this knowledge base.
Pipelines: vector search, keyword search, wiki generation, knowledge graph extraction.

is_pinned.description:
IsPinned and PinnedAt are computed per-caller from user_kb_pins
(see migration 000050). They used to be stored on the row itself,
which made pinning a workspace-wide ordering decision gated behind
the kb-edit RBAC guard. The columns are still present in legacy
schemas for rollback safety but are no longer read or written by
the application — both fields are tagged `gorm:"-"` so GORM
ignores them on every CRUD call and the list handler stamps them
after enriching with the caller's pin set.

is_processing.description: IsProcessing indicates if there is a processing import task (for FAQ type knowledge bases)

is_temporary.description: Whether this knowledge base is temporary (ephemeral) and should be hidden from UI

knowledge_count.description: Knowledge count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

pinned_at.description:
PinnedAt records when the current caller pinned this knowledge
base; nil when they have not.

processing_count.description: ProcessingCount indicates the number of knowledge items being processed (for document type knowledge bases)

profile_config.description:
ProfileConfig controls automatic generation of the knowledge-base
description from per-document profiles (document knowledge bases only).

question_generation_config.description: QuestionGenerationConfig stores question generation configuration for document knowledge bases

require_review.description: RequireReview forces new content through the approval flow.

share_count.description: ShareCount indicates the number of organizations this knowledge base is shared with (not stored in database)

space_kind.description:
SpaceKind distinguishes personal/team/public/project/external-collab
spaces and drives their default policy (V3.0 §4.1). Empty means team.

storage_backend_id.description:
StorageBackendID binds this KB to one concrete storage instance. The
legacy provider field remains readable during migration only.

storage_config.description: Deprecated: legacy COS config column. Kept for backward compatibility with old data.

storage_provider_config.description: Storage provider config (new): only stores provider selection; credentials from workspace StorageEngineConfig

summary_model_id.description:
Summary model ID. model.list returns the ids. Used for summaries, and as
the default for auto-tagging and the AI description.

type.description: Type of the knowledge base: document, faq or wiki. Empty means document.

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the knowledge base

vector_store_id.description:
VectorStoreID references the VectorStore this knowledge base is bound to.
When nil, the KB falls back to the workspace's effective engines derived from
the RETRIEVE_DRIVER environment variable (env store flow).
This field is set once at creation time and must not be modified afterwards;
enforcement lives at the GORM layer (`<-:create`) plus the service-layer
KB update path, which omits this field from its update DTO.

wiki_config.description: WikiConfig stores wiki-specific configuration (only for wiki type knowledge bases)

asr_config.description: ASRConfig replaces speech-recognition settings when set. nil means no change.

auto_tag_config.description: AutoTagConfig controls optional automatic association of existing KB tags.

embedding_model_id.description:
EmbeddingModelID changes the embedding model. nil means no change.
A knowledge base that already has documents cannot switch models.

extract_config.description: ExtractConfig replaces graph extraction settings when set. nil means no change.

faq_config.description: FAQ configuration (only for FAQ type knowledge bases)

image_processing_config.description:
Image processing configuration.

nil means "no change" when updating, the same contract IndexingStrategy
uses. A request that does not mention this field must leave the image
settings alone: the attribute-observation switch and the attribute policy
are things a knowledge base accumulates, and a client that predates them
would otherwise reset the lot on any save. Sending an object — empty
included — replaces the whole configuration.

indexing_strategy.description:
IndexingStrategy controls which indexing pipelines are active.
nil means "no change" when updating (preserves existing strategy).

profile_config.description:
ProfileConfig controls optional automatic knowledge-base description
generation. nil means "no change" when updating.

question_generation_config.description: QuestionGenerationConfig replaces generated-question settings when set. nil means no change.

storage_backend_id.description: StorageBackendID rebinds file storage. nil means no change.

summary_model_id.description: SummaryModelID changes the summary model. nil means no change.

wiki_config.description: Wiki configuration (only for wiki-enabled knowledge bases)

aggregate_hash.description:
AggregateHash identifies the aggregate the gist was generated from. A
mismatch with the live aggregate means the text is stale.

error.description: Error holds the last generation error when Status is failed.

generated_at.description: GeneratedAt records when the text was produced.

gist.description: Gist is a short statement of what the knowledge base covers.

model_id.description: ModelID records which chat model produced the text.

stats.description: Stats is the aggregate snapshot the text was generated from.

status.description: Status is one of the KnowledgeBaseProfileStatus* values.

topics.description: Topics is the merged topic list (at most KnowledgeBaseProfileMaxTopics).

typical_questions.description: TypicalQuestions lists questions this knowledge base can answer.

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions is extra guidance for the description, such as the audience. The format stays fixed.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the AI knowledge-base description on.

model_id.description: ModelID overrides the summary model. Empty uses summary_model_id.

doc_types.description: DocTypes counts documents per model-assigned document type.

document_count.description: DocumentCount is the number of eligible documents at generation time.

earliest_at.description: EarliestAt and LatestAt bound document creation times.

file_types.description: FileTypes counts documents per file extension.

folders.description: Folders lists the top-level folder names present.

profiled_count.description: ProfiledCount is how many of them carried a document profile.

raw_topics.description: RawTopics counts documents per normalized topic keyword before merging.

tags.description: Tags counts documents per knowledge-base tag.

shared_by_user_id.description: User ID who shared the knowledge base

source_tenant_id.description: Original tenant ID of the knowledge base (for cross-tenant embedding model access)

my_permission.description: Effective permission for current user = min(Permission, MyRoleInOrg)

my_role_in_org.description: Current user's role in this organization (admin/editor/viewer)

permission.description: Share permission (what the space was granted: viewer/editor)

cause_candidate.description: CauseCandidate 疑似原因（候选≠定论，措辞保留不确定性）。

evidence_links.description: EvidenceLinks 补充证据链接/单号（与表级 evidence 结构化引用互补）。

measures.description: Measures 处置措施（有序步骤）。

phenomenon.description: Phenomenon 现象/触发条件（什么情况下适用）。

scope.description: Scope 适用范围（机型/工位/工序/工况等边界条件）。

validation.description: Validation 验证情况（如何验证有效、由谁验证）。

what.description: What 一句话结论（这张卡沉淀了什么经验）。

chunk_id.description: ChunkID pins the comment to one chunk of the knowledge (empty = document level).

end_offset.description: EndOffset is the quote's end offset (exclusive; must be >= StartOffset).

quote.description: Quote is the selected text the comment refers to.

start_offset.description: StartOffset is the quote's start offset inside the chunk text (runes).

children.description: Children are the direct sub-folders, sorted by name.

document_count.description: DocumentCount counts entries whose folder_path equals Path.

name.description: Name is the last segment of Path, used as the tree row label.

path.description: Path is the canonical folder path, e.g. "docs/spec".

total_count.description: TotalCount counts entries in Path and in all descendant folders.

folders.description: Folders are the top-level folders, sorted by name.

root_document_count.description:
RootDocumentCount counts entries that live at the knowledge base root
(folder_path = ""), i.e. documents that were not uploaded as part of a
folder.

total_document_count.description:
TotalDocumentCount counts every entry in the knowledge base, matching
the unfiltered document list total.

effectiveStatus.description:
EffectiveStatus applies scheduled effective/expiry windows on top of
Status. It is what search/QA/UI should act on.

reasons.description:
Reasons lists the machine-readable signals that produced EffectiveStatus
(e.g. "not_yet_effective", "expires_at_reached"), for UI badges.

image_actions.description:
ImageActions overrides rows of the attribute->work table for this document
(merged per action key on top of the knowledge base's table).
nil keeps the knowledge base's setting.

image_attrs_enabled.description:
ImageAttrsEnabled overrides the knowledge base's attribute-observed image
pipeline switch for this one document. nil keeps the knowledge base's
setting.

image_pipeline.description:
ImagePipelineID overrides which image pipeline runs for this one
document. nil keeps the knowledge base's resolved pipeline. When set,
ImagePipelineParams travels with it: the params of one pipeline are
meaningless to another, so the pair is replaced as a unit.

image_pipeline_params.description:
ImagePipelineParams are the overridden pipeline's private tunables. They
are only applied together with ImagePipelineID.

image_vector_enabled.description:
ImageVectorEnabled overrides image vector indexing for this document.
It does not change the KB-wide retrieval setting or embedding model.

parser_engine_overrides.description:
ParserEngineOverrides passes key-value configuration to docreader parsers
(e.g. pdf_force_scanned=true). Merged with workspace-level overrides in the
parse pipeline; per-upload values take priority on conflict.

summary_enabled.description: SummaryEnabled defaults to true when omitted for backward compatibility.

doc_type.description: DocType is a coarse label such as "user manual", "meeting notes" or "contract".

gist.description: Gist is a one-line statement of what the document is about.

typical_question.description: TypicalQuestion is one natural-language question this document answers.

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base ID that this tag belongs to

name.description: Tag name, unique within the same knowledge base

seq_id.description: SeqID is an auto-increment integer ID for external API usage

sort_order.description: Sort order within the same knowledge base

description.description: Description explains what completing the step means.

knowledge_id.description:
KnowledgeID points at the knowledge entry to study; empty means a
free-text step (v1 allows offline/offline-training steps).

order.description:
Order is the 1-based position within the path (unique per path;
enforced by the service on write).

resource_counts.description: 各空间内知识库/智能体数量，供列表侧栏展示

memberships.description:
Memberships lists every workspace the user can authenticate into,
along with their role in each. Always populated (length 1 for users
who only belong to their home workspace) so frontends can render a
workspace switcher without a follow-up request. Serialised without
omitempty so the field is always present as a JSON array (possibly
empty) — the "always populated" contract relies on the server side
guaranteeing a non-nil slice.

retry_delay.description: Delay between retries in seconds, default: 1

oauth_required.description:
OAuthRequired is true when the connection failed because the server
requires OAuth authorization (RFC 9728), even though the service was not
configured for OAuth. The UI uses it to guide the user to switch the auth
strategy to OAuth.

annotations.description:
Annotations are the hints the service declares in tools/list. They come
from outside and only seed the tool's risk.

require_approval.description: RequireApproval when true: agent execution pauses until the user approves in UI (issue #1173).

content.description:
Markdown content. The assistant may send a full document; the API limit
is 200000 runes, and x-agent-max-bytes covers that in UTF-8.

status.description: draft keeps the document out of search; publish indexes it.
