embedding_model_id.description:
EmbeddingModelID is the single model used to score memory against a
question. It is pinned per workspace: knowledge bases each have their
own embedding model, and grabbing whichever one happens to be listed
first would mix incomparable vector spaces. Blank means semantic recall
is off and matching stays lexical.

enabled.description:
Enabled defaults to false. Memory retains user statements across
sessions, so a workspace admin has to turn it on deliberately.

extract_delay_seconds.description:
ExtractDelaySeconds is how long a finished turn waits before
distillation runs. Waiting lets one model call cover the several
messages a user usually sends in a row. 0 means the default.

extract_instructions.description:
ExtractInstructions are workspace-specific rules appended to the
distillation prompt, for policies the product cannot guess ("never record
customer names", "always note the environment a question is about").

extract_min_interval_seconds.description:
ExtractMinIntervalSeconds is the floor between two distillation runs for
the same person, and exists purely to bound cost. It never drops a turn:
a turn arriving inside the interval is queued and picked up by the next
run. 0 means the default.

extract_model_id.description:
ExtractModelID is the model used by the background extraction task.
Empty means "use the model the conversation itself used", which is what
the settings UI promises, so the extraction task must never fail merely
because this is blank.

interest_threshold.description:
InterestThreshold is how many separate conversations must touch a topic
before it becomes a stored interest. 0 means the default. Setting it to 1
records every topic on first sight, which is usually too noisy.

max_items.description: MaxItems caps active items per subject. 0 means DefaultMemoryMaxItems.

retrieval_conditioning.description:
RetrievalConditioning lets memory shape retrieval — query rewriting and
per-document ranking — rather than only being appended to the answer
prompt. This is where memory earns its keep in a knowledge-base product.

vector_recall.description:
VectorRecall adds semantic similarity to memory recall. Nil means on
when an embedding model is reachable.

Lexical matching alone cannot find a memory the user has re-worded, which
is most of them: "回答直接给结论" and "别铺垫那么多" share no tokens. The
cost is one embedding call per turn, bounded and degraded to lexical on
failure, so the feature never becomes a reason a chat is slow.

candidates.description: Candidates is how many groups were put in front of the model.

reviewed.description: Reviewed is how many active memories the pass looked at.

skipped.description: Skipped is why nothing was merged, empty when something was.

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt is when the statement stops being worth recalling, used for
things that are true only for a while ("finish the migration this week").
Without it an in-flight task stays in context forever and slowly turns
the memory into a list of things the user finished months ago.

normalized_key.description:
NormalizedKey identifies the topic this item is about. A new item with
the same key as an active one supersedes it, which is how contradictions
("I use MySQL" then "I moved to Postgres") resolve without an LLM in the
read path.

topic.description:
Topic is the readable subject the statement is about, as the extraction
model named it ("在用的数据库"). It is kept verbatim next to the
normalized key because it is the best retrieval handle available: a
question often names the topic while the statement itself only carries
the value ("已经迁到 PostgreSQL").

effective.description: Effective is what actually happens: WorkspaceEnabled && UserEnabled.

item_count.description: ItemCount is how many active memories the caller currently has.

max_items.description: MaxItems is the capacity cap after which the lowest ranked are archived.

user_enabled.description:
UserEnabled is the caller's own opt out. Meaningless while the
workspace switch is off, but still reported so the toggle keeps its
position when an admin turns the workspace back on.

workspace_enabled.description: WorkspaceEnabled is the admin switch on the workspace.

write_mode.description: WriteMode is the workspace write mode.

label.description: Label is the text the author typed (display only).

kb_id.description: Parent knowledge base for file/tag mentions

service_id.description: Parent MCP service for MCP tool mentions

agent_duration_ms.description: Agent total execution duration in milliseconds (from query start to answer start)

agent_id.description:
AgentID is the agent used for this individual assistant turn. Unlike the
session's last_request_state it remains stable when users switch agents.

agent_steps.description:
Agent execution steps (only for assistant messages generated by agent)
This contains the detailed reasoning process and tool calls made by the agent
Stored for user history display, but NOT included in LLM context to avoid redundancy

artifacts.description:
Skill-generated files produced during this assistant turn (assistant messages only).
Populated by ArtifactCollector after the sandbox finishes, referenced by the
artifact download endpoint. Empty for user messages and turns without skills.

Stored in the message_artifacts table, not on the message row: the message
repository loads it with every message it returns and writes it whenever it
is non-nil on create or update. A nil slice leaves the stored rows alone.

attachments.description: Attached files (documents, audio, etc., for user messages)

channel.description: Channel indicates the source channel of this message (e.g., "web", "api", "im")

collaboration_status.description:
CollaborationStatus is projected from durable collaboration state at read
time, including completed tasks after the transient stream has expired.

images.description: Attached images with OCR/Caption text (for user messages)

is_fallback.description: Whether this response is a fallback (no knowledge base match found)

knowledge_id.description:
KnowledgeID links this message to a Knowledge entry in the chat history knowledge base
Used for vector search indexing: when set, the message content has been indexed as a Knowledge passage

knowledge_references.description: References to knowledge chunks used in the response

mentioned_items.description:
Mentioned knowledge bases and files (for user messages)
Stores the @mentioned items when user sends a message

model_id.description:
ModelID is the requested/effective chat model binding captured for this
turn. It is useful for reproducibility and suggestion generation.

prompt_history.description:
PendingPrompt is the prompt an awaiting_input message waits on. The
message list fills it in for the prompt's owner; it is never stored.

request_id.description: Request identifier for tracking API requests

run_state.description:
RunState refines an incomplete message: MessageRunStateAwaitingInput
means the run ended suspended on a prompt instead of still generating.
Empty means IsCompleted alone describes the message.

sandbox_checkpoint.description:
SandboxCheckpoint is the git commit this assistant turn produced in the
session sandbox's /workspace. Nil for user messages, for turns that ran
without a sandbox, and for turns whose commit failed (best-effort — a
failed checkpoint must never block the reply). A message without a
checkpoint cannot serve as a fork point with sandbox state.

session_id.description: ID of the session this message belongs to

usage.description:
LLM token usage aggregated across every round of the turn that produced this
assistant message. Persisted so history reads can attribute cost after the
live stream is gone; NULL (nil) for user messages and pre-feature rows.

used_memories.description:
UsedMemories records which long-term memories were injected into this
answer, so the chat UI can show them and let the user delete one on the
spot. Persisted rather than only streamed so reopening a conversation
still explains what the answer saw.

deleted_at.description:
DeletedAt marks a file the user deleted. The entry stays in the list
rather than being removed because its position IS the download address
(msg.Artifacts[index]); dropping it would shift every later file's index
and hand an old link the wrong blob. Keeping it also keeps the entry in
ArtifactCollector's de-duplication set, so the next collect does not
re-attach the very file that was deleted — its sandbox mtime has not
moved. Clients filter these out; the bytes are already reclaimed.

source_path.description: Absolute path inside the sandbox (used for diff)

url.description: Storage URL (provider://path); persisted, not sent to client

content.description: Extracted text content (for small text files)

id.description: Temporary document ID for session-scoped uploads

selected_chunks.description: Chunks included in this message prompt

token_count.description: Approximate tokens in the parsed document

answer_content.description: Assistant answer content (role=assistant), may be empty if only Q matched

created_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest message in the group

match_type.description: How this result was matched: "keyword", "vector", or "hybrid"

request_id.description: The request_id that groups Q&A together

score.description: Best score among the matched messages in this group

app_secret.description: AES-256 加密存储，实际承载上游 API Key

context_window.description:
ContextWindow is the model's total context window in tokens and
MaxOutputTokens the most it emits in one response. Both are provider
facts the agent cannot discover but has to act on: the context window is
what decides when conversation history gets compacted, and assuming a
window larger than the real one means compaction never fires and the
provider rejects the request mid-conversation instead. 0 means unknown,
which falls back to DefaultMaxContextTokens.

custom_headers.description:
CustomHeaders 允许在调用远程模型 API 时附加自定义 HTTP 请求头，
用途类似 Python OpenAI SDK 的 extra_headers 参数，
常见场景包括透传企业网关鉴权信息、追踪 ID、路由标识等。
保留字段（Authorization、api-key、Content-Type、Accept 等）会在运行期被忽略以避免破坏签名/鉴权流程。

max_concurrency.description:
MaxConcurrency caps concurrent in-flight BACKGROUND (ingestion /
enrichment) calls to THIS specific model, keyed by model ID and shared
across all replicas. 0 (the default) means "fall back to the
process-wide model.max_concurrency". Interactive user-facing calls are
never gated. Only chat / vlm / embedding honour this (see limiter.Gate).

provider.description: Provider identifier: openai, aliyun, zhipu, generic

spec.description:
Spec overrides the catalog entry for this row: protocol, capability
flags and the flat protocol compat object. Everything omitted is
inherited from the vendor catalog (see internal/models/catalog).

supports_vision.description: Whether the model accepts image/multimodal input

compat.description:
Compat is a plain object so it round-trips through both JSON (API,
database column) and YAML (builtin_models.yaml).

avatar.description: Avatar URL for display in list and settings

invite_code.description: Unique invitation code for joining the organization

invite_code_expires_at.description: When the current invite code expires; nil means no expiry

member_limit.description: Max members allowed; 0 means no limit

owner_id.description: User ID of the organization owner

owner_tenant_id.description:
OwnerTenantID is the tenant the owner belonged to when the
organization was created. Plan 3 (#1303) treats this tenant as
the org's "owning tenant": its membership row in
organization_tenant_members is undeletable / unchangeable so
the org can never be orphaned even if the owner user later
switches tenants or is soft-deleted. See migration 000046.

searchable.description: Whether the space is open for search (discoverable; non-members can search and join by org ID)

prev_role.description: Previous role before upgrade (only for upgrade requests)

request_type.description: Type of request: 'join' for new member, 'upgrade' for role upgrade

reviewed_at.description: Time when the request was reviewed

reviewed_by.description: User ID of the admin who reviewed the request

agent_share_count.description: 共享到该组织的智能体数量

has_pending_upgrade.description: 当前用户是否有待处理的权限升级申请

owner_tenant_id.description:
OwnerTenantID is the persisted owner workspace of the organization
(Plan 3, migration 000046). Frontend uses this to identify the
"owner row" in the workspace-keyed members list — comparing
member.tenant_id against owner_tenant_id is the post-Plan-3
equivalent of the old member.user_id == owner_id check.

pending_join_request_count.description: 待审批加入申请数（仅管理员可见）

share_count.description: 共享到该组织的知识库数量

disabled_by_me.description: DisabledByMe: current tenant has hidden this shared agent from their conversation dropdown (per-user preference)

web_search_ready.description:
WebSearchReady is resolved against the source workspace without exposing
its provider list or credentials. Receivers must not compare the agent's
provider ID with their own workspace resources.

section.description: part of the page in view, e.g. an editor tab

selection.description: Selection is the text the user selected on the page. Assistant only.

title.description:
Title is the page's name as the client's navigation shows it, e.g.
"Agents"; it names pages without an identifier. Assistant only.

view.description:
View is the title of the dialog or drawer open over the page, as the
page shows it. Assistant only.

chat_parser_engine_rules.description:
ChatParserEngineRules selects parser engines for session-scoped chat
documents. Knowledge bases keep their own rules in ChunkingConfig.

mineru_cloud_model.description: MinerU 云 API 解析参数

mineru_enable_ocr.description:
MinerUEnableOCR is retained for compatibility with configurations saved
before parse_method supported auto/ocr/txt.

mineru_model.description: 以下 backend、vLLM、公式/表格、语言参数仅对 3.x 及更早版本生效。

mineru_server_api_key.description: MinerU 自建解析参数。协议按服务端自动识别：4.0+ 走 V1 API，更早版本走 /file_parse。

odl_hybrid.description: OpenDataLoader PDF (docreader engine); hybrid requires opendataloader-pdf-hybrid service.

xlsx_first_row_as_header.description:
XLSXFirstRowAsHeader restores row-1 column context for flat XLSX tables.
nil preserves the parser default; an explicit false disables the mode.

description.description: Description explains what this placeholder represents

label.description: Label is a short label for the placeholder

name.description: Name is the placeholder name (without braces), e.g., "query"

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions describes who the questions are for. The question format stays fixed.

enabled.description: Enabled turns question generation on. Generated questions are indexed beside the chunk.

model_id.description: ModelID selects a chat model for questions. Empty inherits the summary model.

question_count.description: QuestionCount is how many questions to write per chunk, from 1 to 10.

latency_ms.description: LatencyMs is the age of the oldest pending task, in milliseconds.

memory_usage_bytes.description: MemoryUsageBytes is the approximate Redis memory the queue occupies.

paused.description: Paused reports whether the queue is paused (tasks not consumed).

pool.description: Pool is the independent worker pool that drains this queue.

processed.description: Processed / Failed are today's counters (reset daily).

size.description:
Size is the total number of tasks in the queue (pending + active +
scheduled + retry + aggregating + archived).

weight.description: Weight is the queue's scheduling weight inside its pool.

requested_role.description: The role user wants to upgrade to

applied.description: Applied is true when rerank scores decided the returned order.

error.description: Error carries the reason for model_error / model_unavailable.

images_scored.description:
ImagesScored counts image hits a multimodal reranker scored by their
image; ImagesKept the pictorial image hits kept over a text reranker's
rejection on their vector's evidence.

model_id.description: ModelID and ModelSource (request / tenant / auto) identify the model.

threshold.description:
Threshold is the requested minimum score; EffectiveThreshold is the one
applied after degradation.

top_score.description: TopScore is the best rerank model score among the candidates.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the rerank stage off when explicitly false. Nil means on.

model_id.description:
ModelID selects the rerank model. Empty falls back to the tenant
RetrievalConfig, then to the first rerank model of the tenant.

threshold.description:
Threshold is the minimum rerank model score. Nil uses the tenant
RetrievalConfig. A pointer because 0 and negative scores are valid.

top_k.description: TopK caps the reranked results. Zero uses the endpoint's result count.

external_id.description: Unique identifier in the external system

has_children.description: Whether this resource has children that can be expanded

modified_at.description: Last modified time in external system

parent_id.description: For hierarchical resources (parent ID if applicable)

type.description: Resource type (document, folder, space, page, etc.)

url.description: URL to access in external system

embedding_top_k.description: EmbeddingTopK is the maximum number of chunks returned by vector search (default: 50)

keyword_threshold.description: KeywordThreshold is the minimum keyword match score (0-1, default: 0.3)

rerank_model_id.description: RerankModelID is the ID of the rerank model to use (required for search)

rerank_threshold.description: RerankThreshold is the minimum rerank score (-10 to 10, default: 0.2)

rerank_top_k.description: RerankTopK is the maximum number of results after reranking (default: 10)

rrf_k.description:
RRFK is the smoothing constant of Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Larger values
flatten the curve, reducing the bias towards top-1 results.
Default: 60. Sensible range: 30..100 depending on corpus size.

rrf_keyword_weight.description: RRFKeywordWeight is the keyword counterpart. Default: 0.3.

rrf_vector_weight.description:
RRFVectorWeight is the weight applied to the vector retriever inside RRF.
RRFVectorWeight + RRFKeywordWeight should usually sum to 1.0 but the math
works for any positive weights. Default: 0.7.

vector_threshold.description: VectorThreshold is the minimum vector similarity score (0-1, default: 0.15)

role.description: Optional: role to assign when approving; overrides applicant's requested role

error_category.description: ErrorCategory is a heuristic summary; raw upstream errors are not sent to the assistant.

department.description: Department is the department display name the IdP reports.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the group name; unique per tenant.

externalId.description: ExternalID is the IdP's identifier (stable across renames).

active.description: Active controls whether the account may sign in.

emails.description: Emails are the address entries; the primary one is the account email.

externalId.description: ExternalID is the IdP's identifier (stable across renames).

groups.description: Groups lists the groups the user belongs to (read-only projection).

name.description: Name is the display name parts.

urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:e.description: EnterpriseUser carries the department attribute when the IdP sends it.

userName.description: UserName is the login name (required by SCIM).

background_active.description:
BackgroundActive marks a commit taken while background work was live in
the session. The work may have been mid-write, so fork and rewind never
roll a workspace back to it.

allow_out.description:
AllowOut accepts IPv4, IPv4 CIDR, a DNS name, or a single-label
wildcard such as "*.example.com". Domain entries are only meaningful
together with a deny-all; see ValidateSandboxNetworkPolicy.

allow_public_inbound.description:
AllowPublicInbound is accepted on the wire for old payloads and then
cleared. Inbound is always credential-required; a true value has no
runtime effect.

cube_rules.description:
CubeRules are validated whenever present and consumed only by the Cube
provider adapter.

deny_egress_by_default.description:
DenyEgressByDefault installs a 0.0.0.0/0 deny-all, after which only
AllowOut (and L7 rule targets) can reach the network. false allows
public egress, which is what skill installs need.

deny_out.description:
DenyOut accepts IPv4 and IPv4 CIDR only. Neither provider can deny a
domain: denial is a pure longest-prefix match on the destination IP.

e2b_host_rules.description:
E2BHostRules are validated whenever present and consumed only by the E2B
provider adapter.

disable_keywords_match.description: Turns keyword matching off, leaving vector matching only.

disable_vector_match.description: Turns vector matching off, leaving keyword matching only.

exclude_knowledge_ids.description:
ExcludeKnowledgeIDs drops these knowledge IDs from recall. The knowledge
base service fills it from the lifecycle state machine (draft, pending
review, expired, replaced, delisted, archived entries never back answers;
V3.0 §7.1). Explicit IDs win: when KnowledgeIDs is set, the caller asked
for specific documents and lifecycle filtering still applies to the rest.

keyword_threshold.description: Minimum keyword score a hit needs; 0 keeps every keyword hit.

knowledge_base_ids.description:
KnowledgeBaseIDs overrides the single KB ID passed to HybridSearch,
allowing a single retrieval call to span multiple KBs that share the
same embedding model. When empty, HybridSearch uses its own id parameter.

knowledge_ids.description: Limits the search to these documents of the knowledge base.

match_count.description: Number of chunks to return; 0 uses the default.

query_text.description:
QueryText is required unless query_embedding is provided, keyword matching is disabled,
and vector matching remains enabled.

rerank.description:
Rerank, when present and enabled, reranks the fused candidates before
truncating to MatchCount. Only the hybrid-search API reads it; internal
callers rerank on their own.

skip_context_enrichment.description:
SkipContextEnrichment skips fetching parent, nearby, and relation chunks
in processSearchResults. Used by the chat pipeline where context assembly
is handled separately in the merge stage.

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs for filtering (used for FAQ priority filtering)

vector_threshold.description: Minimum vector similarity a hit needs; 0 keeps every vector hit.

chunk_metadata.description: ChunkMetadata stores chunk-level metadata (e.g., generated questions)

knowledge_base_id.description: KnowledgeBaseID is the ID of the knowledge base this result belongs to

knowledge_channel.description: KnowledgeChannel indicates through which channel the knowledge was ingested (web, api, wechat, etc.)

knowledge_classification.description:
KnowledgeClassification is the source document's classification at
retrieval time. Carried on the hit so the Evidence Pack permission
snapshot (§13.4) and the citation redaction path (§2.7) can decide
without a second lookup.

knowledge_custom_metadata.description: KnowledgeCustomMetadata is user-authored context safe to expose to models.

knowledge_description.description: KnowledgeDescription is the description of the knowledge document

knowledge_filename.description:
Knowledge file name
Used for file type knowledge, contains the original file name

knowledge_lifecycle_status.description:
KnowledgeLifecycleStatus is the source document's lifecycle state at
retrieval time, for the same reason.

knowledge_source.description:
Knowledge source
Used to indicate the source of the knowledge, such as "url"

matched_content.description:
MatchedContent is the actual content that was matched in vector search
For FAQ: this is the matched question text (standard or similar question)

matched_images.description:
MatchedImages survives merging, deduplication and stored reference replay.
It contains storage references, never image bytes.

source_locators.description:
SourceLocators point back into the original file for citation
navigation. Merged results carry the union of their chunks' locators.

agent_share_count.description: 共享到该组织的智能体数量

forked_from_message_id.description:
ForkedFromMessageID is the user or assistant message, IN THE PARENT
SESSION, that the fork branched at. For a user point, messages strictly
before it were copied here. For an assistant point, that answer is
included so the branch continues after it.

host_workspace_dir.description:
HostWorkspaceDir is the user-selected project directory this session
operates in, for the WeKnora Lite host sandbox only. Empty means the session
gets an auto-allocated workspace instead.

Written once at creation and never updated: re-pointing a live session
at a different directory would leave its transcript describing files
that are no longer there. Standard edition never writes it.

im_platform.description:
IMPlatform is the originating IM platform (e.g. "feishu", "wecom") when
this session is bound to an IM channel. It is not stored on the sessions
table (it lives in im_channel_sessions) and is populated on read so the
Web console can classify a session's origin folder without a list query.

is_pinned.description: IsPinned indicates whether the session is pinned in the list.

kind.description:
Kind is empty for ordinary chats and SessionKindAssistant for assistant
conversations; it is set at creation and never updated.

last_request_state.description:
LastRequestState records the input-bar state used the last time this
session sent a question (agent, model, KB scope, web search, MCPs).
Persisted on every successful POST to /knowledge-chat or /agent-chat so
that reopening the session can restore the original request context to
the chat UI. Stored in the legacy sessions.agent_config JSONB column to
avoid a new migration; the shape used today is `SessionLastRequestState`.

owner_auth_source.description:
OwnerAuthSource records, server-side, how UserID was authenticated when
the session was created or its owner first bound (AuthSource*).
Per-user sandbox allocation reads it; client input never sets it
(CreateSession overwrites). Empty on rows created before the column
existed, which means "unknown".

parent_session_id.description:
ParentSessionID names the session this one was forked from. Empty for
ordinary sessions. Deliberately not a foreign key: the parent may be
deleted while the branch lives on, and a branch must not cascade away
with it. A dangling value simply renders as an ordinary session.

pinned_at.description: PinnedAt records when the session was pinned; nil when not pinned.

sandbox_config_id.description:
SandboxConfigID pins which sandbox config this session's CURRENT live
sandbox was created on. Empty means no live sandbox;
SandboxConfigIDGlobalDefault means the deployment-wide default config.

This is an ephemeral pin that dies with the sandbox, not a permanent
owner: sessions outlive sandboxes by months, so treating it as
permanent would make "no session references this config" never true.

user_id.description:
UserID is the owner scope for this session. WeKnora user UUIDs, API
external-user principals, and embed visitor principals all use this column.

forked_from_message_id.description:
ForkedFromMessageID is the user or assistant message, IN THE PARENT
SESSION, that the fork branched at. For a user point, messages strictly
before it were copied here. For an assistant point, that answer is
included so the branch continues after it.

host_workspace_dir.description:
HostWorkspaceDir is the user-selected project directory this session
operates in, for the WeKnora Lite host sandbox only. Empty means the session
gets an auto-allocated workspace instead.

Written once at creation and never updated: re-pointing a live session
at a different directory would leave its transcript describing files
that are no longer there. Standard edition never writes it.

is_pinned.description: IsPinned indicates whether the session is pinned in the list.

kind.description:
Kind is empty for ordinary chats and SessionKindAssistant for assistant
conversations; it is set at creation and never updated.

last_request_state.description:
LastRequestState records the input-bar state used the last time this
session sent a question (agent, model, KB scope, web search, MCPs).
Persisted on every successful POST to /knowledge-chat or /agent-chat so
that reopening the session can restore the original request context to
the chat UI. Stored in the legacy sessions.agent_config JSONB column to
avoid a new migration; the shape used today is `SessionLastRequestState`.

owner_auth_source.description:
OwnerAuthSource records, server-side, how UserID was authenticated when
the session was created or its owner first bound (AuthSource*).
Per-user sandbox allocation reads it; client input never sets it
(CreateSession overwrites). Empty on rows created before the column
existed, which means "unknown".

parent_session_id.description:
ParentSessionID names the session this one was forked from. Empty for
ordinary sessions. Deliberately not a foreign key: the parent may be
deleted while the branch lives on, and a branch must not cascade away
with it. A dangling value simply renders as an ordinary session.

pinned_at.description: PinnedAt records when the session was pinned; nil when not pinned.

sandbox_config_id.description:
SandboxConfigID pins which sandbox config this session's CURRENT live
sandbox was created on. Empty means no live sandbox;
SandboxConfigIDGlobalDefault means the deployment-wide default config.

This is an ephemeral pin that dies with the sandbox, not a permanent
owner: sessions outlive sandboxes by months, so treating it as
permanent would make "no session references this config" never true.

user_id.description:
UserID is the owner scope for this session. WeKnora user UUIDs, API
external-user principals, and embed visitor principals all use this column.

approval_status.description: ApprovalStatus is 'approved' in v1 (直通); 'pending' is reserved.

created_by.description: CreatedBy is the authenticated user that issued the link.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is the link expiry; nil means the link lives until revoked.

id.description: Unique identifier of the share link.

knowledge_id.description: KnowledgeID is the shared source document.

revoked_at.description: RevokedAt is set when the link is revoked; nil means still active.

tenant_id.description: TenantID is the owning workspace (the knowledge owner's tenant).

token.description: Token is the visitor credential (see the generation规范 above).

visit_count.description: VisitCount is the total number of resolved visits (never trimmed).

visit_log.description:
VisitLog holds the most recent ShareLinkVisit entries (newest first,
capped at ShareLinkVisitLogMaxEntries).

current_version.description: CurrentVersion is the latest published version number.

download_available.description:
DownloadAvailable distinguishes "no permission" from "signing not
configured": true whenever permission=download and a URL was minted.

download_url.description:
DownloadURL is the presigned file address. Present only when the
link's permission is download AND the deployment can sign URLs; it is
a relative URL (the visitor's origin is the prefix).

effective_status.description:
EffectiveStatus is the read-time resolved behaviour (e.g. a valid row
past its expires_at reads as expired here too).

file_name.description: FileName / FileType / FileSize describe the source file.

lifecycle_reasons.description:
LifecycleReasons carries the machine-readable signals behind
EffectiveStatus (mirrors KnowledgeLifecycleResolved.Reasons).

lifecycle_status.description: LifecycleStatus is the stored lifecycle state.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt mirrors the row; nil = valid until revoked.

permission.description: Permission is the capability granted (view | download).

token.description:
Token echoes the resolved credential so the page can render the
visitor watermark without re-parsing its own URL.

visited_at.description: VisitedAt is the timestamp of this very visit.

disabled_by_me.description: DisabledByMe: current tenant has hidden this shared agent from their conversation dropdown (per-user preference)

web_search_ready.description:
WebSearchReady is resolved against the source workspace without exposing
its provider list or credentials. Receivers must not compare the agent's
provider ID with their own workspace resources.

base_template_id.description:
BaseTemplateID is the template this chain was originally built from;
the rebuild path starts over from it.

built_at.description: BuiltAt records when this generation was produced.

generation.description:
Generation increments on every successful install/remove, for naming
and troubleshooting.

owner_fingerprint.description:
OwnerFingerprint identifies the provider account that owns the snapshot.
Snapshots are invisible across accounts, so a mismatch means "fall back
to the base template" rather than "fail".

snapshot_id.description: SnapshotID is the currently effective snapshot; empty = base template.

bbox.description:
BBox is [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the page width and height,
origin at the top-left corner of the rendered page.

block.description: Block is the 1-based index among a Word file's body paragraphs and tables.

mapping.description: Mapping records verified text-to-source alignment. Empty means legacy.

partial.description: Partial means some of the chunk has no source mapping.

quote.description:
Quote is the complete cited overlap as parsed. Viewers match it
inside the rendered original and against the
answer sentence that cites the chunk.

section.description: Section is the 1-based EPUB spine index.

sheet.description:
Sheet is the spreadsheet sheet name; RowStart/RowEnd are its 1-based
row numbers as shown by spreadsheet applications.

slide.description: Slide is the 1-based slide number in presentation order.

source_hash.description: SourceHash binds the locator to the knowledge record’s source revision hash.

source_id.description: SourceID identifies a block within the parser result, not a rendered item.

start.description: Start/End are rune offsets into the original text file.

title.description: Title names the section or slide when the source has one.

force_path_style.description: ForcePathStyle (S3 specific) - whether to use path-style URLs

secret_id.description: Secret ID (COS) / Access Key ID (S3, MinIO)

secret_key.description: Secret Key (COS) / Secret Access Key (S3, MinIO)

use_ssl.description: UseSSL (S3 specific) - whether to use HTTPS

role.description: Optional: role the applicant requests (admin/editor/viewer); default viewer

knowledge_base_id.description: 来源知识库ID（仅 faq/document/wiki 来源时有值）

knowledge_id.description: 来源文档ID（仅 faq/document 来源时有值）

reasoning_effort.description: ReasoningEffort is the graded thinking level; empty falls back to Thinking.

thinking.description: Thinking - whether to enable thinking mode

items_created.description: New items created in knowledge base

status.description: Sync status: running, success, partial, failed, canceled

category.description:
Category groups settings in the management UI ("limits", "agent",
"auth", ...). Free-form string so adding a new category is a
data-only change.

enum.description:
Enum is populated by the service layer (NOT persisted) from the
in-code registry. Empty/nil means "free-form input"; non-empty
means the UI should render a select with these options. Tagged
`gorm:"-"` so GORM never tries to read/write the column.

is_secret.description:
IsSecret reserves UI affordances for P3 (mask + reveal-with-confirm).
In P1 every row is is_secret=false; service Update accepts the
column but does not yet enforce special handling.

last_modified_by_name.description:
LastModifiedByName is a display label resolved from LastModifiedBy
(the user's UUID) at handler time — username when available,
otherwise email. Empty for virtual rows that were never persisted
(LastModifiedBy=""). Not stored: derived per request so renaming
a user reflects on the next reload without a backfill job.

requires_restart.description:
RequiresRestart reserves UI affordances for P3 (banner "this
change won't take effect until the next restart"). In P1 the
only seeded key is per-request, so always false.

value_type.description:
ValueType is one of "int", "string", "bool". Service layer rejects
updates whose payload type does not match; UI uses it to pick
InputNumber vs Input vs Switch.

assistant_config.description: Assistant config: display name and access ceiling of the WeKnora assistant

chat_history_config.description: Chat history config: knowledge base configuration for indexing and searching chat messages via vector search

context_config.description: Global Context configuration for this workspace (default for all sessions)

credentials.description: Credentials config: third-party provider credentials (e.g. WeKnoraCloud AppID/AppSecret)

default_settings.description: Default settings: the workspace's default model for each type and purpose

default_storage_backend_id.description: DefaultStorageBackendID is the workspace default concrete storage instance.

memory_config.description: Memory config: workspace switch for cross-session long-term memory

parser_engine_config.description: Parser engine config overrides (MinerU endpoint, API key, etc.). Used when parsing documents; overrides env.

retrieval_config.description: Retrieval config: global search/retrieval parameters shared by knowledge search and message search

storage_engine_config.description: Storage engine config: parameters for Local, MinIO, COS. Used for document/file storage and docreader.

storage_quota.description: Storage quota (Bytes), default is 10GB, including vector, original file, text, index, etc.

web_search_config.description: Global WebSearch configuration for this workspace

accepted_count.description:
AcceptedCount mirrors TenantInvitation.AcceptedCount. Surfaced
for share-link rows so the management UI can show "N 人已通过此
链接加入"; informational only for per-user invitations.

invite_url.description:
InviteURL is set on share-link rows that are still pending.
Composed by the handler from FrontendBaseURL + the row's plaintext
token, so the management UI can render a "copy link" button per
row without ever exposing the raw token through the JSON wire.

is_share_link.description:
IsShareLink is a convenience flag so the SPA doesn't have to
special-case "invitee_user_id == ''" everywhere when distinguishing
share-link rows from per-user invitations.

allocation_mode.description:
AllocationMode decides how a session that has not yet used a sandbox
of this config is placed: "session" (default) gives it a machine of its
own, "user" lets one verified owner's sessions share a machine. A
session never changes mode after its first use; see
internal/sandbox/allocation.

allow_private_endpoints.description:
AllowPrivateEndpoints permits this workspace config to reach RFC1918 or
loopback cluster endpoints. Link-local/cloud-metadata addresses remain
blocked. It is explicit in the UI instead of hidden in process env.

default_timeout_sec.description:
DefaultTimeoutSec is the per-execution timeout in seconds. 0 uses the
program's built-in default.

desktop_enabled.description:
DesktopEnabled declares that this config's base template is a desktop
image (XFCE + x11vnc + websockify). It is NOT a second template: a
config has exactly one boot target, and skill snapshots stack on top of
this base generation after generation. Flipping it changes the base, so
any installed skills must be rebuilt from the new one.

env_vars.description:
EnvVars are additional environment variables injected into every
sandbox created for this tenant. 🔒 Values are encrypted at rest.
These become visible to all scripts running in the tenant's
sandboxes — do not place secrets here that scripts must not access.

network.description:
Network is the outbound/inbound network policy applied to every sandbox
created from this config — chat sessions, skill installs and deep
connectivity probes alike. nil and the zero value mean the same thing:
outbound egress allowed, inbound public access closed.

sandbox_type.description: SandboxType is cube, e2b, or docker; disabled is the hidden policy row.

skill_image.description:
SkillImage points at the snapshot that carries this config's installed
skills. Empty means "use the base template". Written only by the skill
install/remove path: MergeSandboxConfigForUpdate ignores client values
so a settings-form save cannot wipe or plant the pointer.

skill_rollout.description:
SkillRollout decides whether sessions that already hold a sandbox of
this config rebuild after a skill install or removal. Empty and
SkillRolloutNextTurn rebuild on the next chat turn. SkillRolloutNewSession
leaves those sandboxes on the previous image; only sessions that start
afterwards boot the new snapshot.
User allocation always keeps existing shared machines, regardless of this setting.

terminal_idle_disconnect_sec.description:
TerminalIdleDisconnectSec is how long an interactive terminal or
desktop may go without user activity before WeKnora closes the
connection so the sandbox can pause on its provider TTL. Terminal
counts keystrokes and PTY output; desktop counts mouse and keyboard.
0 uses the built-in default (15 minutes). Not an identity field.

user_sandbox_empty_retention_days.description:
UserSandboxEmptyRetentionDays is how long a user machine with no live
session is kept before the reclaim job deletes it. 0 means the default
(7); values above 90 are rejected.

volume_mount.description:
VolumeMount configures an optional shared volume mounted into every
sandbox created for this tenant. Currently used for tenant-installed
skills, but the configuration itself is skill-agnostic and can serve
any volume-mount use case (shared datasets, pre-installed toolchains,
etc.).

cached_tokens.description:
CachedTokens is the legacy alias for CacheReadTokens. It remains on the
wire for compatibility with existing API consumers.

context_token_scale.description:
ContextTokenScale is provider prompt tokens per cl100k-estimated token,
measured over the turn's rounds. Persisted with the turn so the next
turn's history loading and first compaction check are calibrated before
any provider count of their own. Zero when the turn measured none.

reflection.description: Agent's reflection on this tool call result (if enabled)

target.description: Target identifies the actual proxy target; Name/Args retain the model call for replay.

images.description: Base64 data URIs from tool (e.g. MCP image content)

searchable.description: open for search so others can discover and join

can_access_all_tenants.description: Whether the user can access all workspaces (cross-workspace access)

is_system_admin.description: Whether the user is a system administrator (independent of workspace roles)

preferences.description:
Per-user UI/feature preferences.
Stored as JSON (jsonb on Postgres, TEXT on SQLite) via the
driver.Valuer / sql.Scanner methods on UserPreferences.

tenant.description: Association relationship, not stored in the database

tenant_id.description: Workspace ID that the user belongs to

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the user

browser_search_instructions.description: BrowserSearchInstructions customizes browser search for this user. Nil/empty uses the platform default.

gallery.description:
Gallery holds the user's image-gallery UI state: the search
activation mode and the per-attribute search-field toggles. Written
by the gallery's mode / checkbox interactions via the preferences
PUT; read back by GET /knowledge-bases/:id/gallery-config so the
gallery renders the same activation state on every device. Nil = the
user never touched the gallery controls (mode defaults to "all").

last_active_tenant_id.description:
LastActiveTenantID remembers the last workspace the user actively
switched into, so a fresh login (new device, cleared browser, new
refresh token) lands them back in that workspace instead of always
bouncing to their home workspace. Written by the SPA's preferences
PUT and by service-level SwitchTenant (including when switching
home, which stores the home ID). Login / RefreshToken validate that
the workspace still exists and the user still has an active membership
(or CanAccessAllTenants) before honouring this preference; an
invalid pointer is best-effort cleared and the user falls back to
home. Refresh JWT claims have no tenant_id, so RefreshToken
re-resolves from this field.

nil  = no preference (use user.TenantID, i.e. home)
*0   = "clear preference" sentinel for the partial-update endpoint
       (UpdateUserPreferences turns this into nil). Otherwise treat
       a stored *0 the same as nil.
*N   = preferred workspace id.

oidc_only_login.description:
OidcOnlyLogin is set server-side when an account is auto-provisioned
via OIDC with a random password the user never received. The profile
UI hides self-service password rotation until the user sets a known
password via ChangePassword (which clears this flag).

custom_instructions.description: CustomInstructions adds image-reading guidance. The OCR and Markdown format stay fixed.

description_language.description: DescriptionLanguage is the language of generated image captions. Empty follows the document language.

enabled.description: Enabled turns image captions on. Also send vlm_model_id.

model_id.description: Model that writes image captions. model.list returns the ids.

enum.description:
Enum constrains the allowed string values. Empty means no
constraint. Used by fields whose value space is closed (e.g.
OpenSearch's knn_engine ∈ {"lucene", "faiss"}).

immutable.description:
Immutable marks a field whose value cannot be changed after the
VectorStore is first created. The UI shows the input as read-only
in edit mode; the backend rejects modification attempts. Used by
engines whose underlying index structure is fixed at create time
(e.g. OpenSearch's HNSW engine / M / ef_construction).

min.description:
Min / Max set inclusive bounds for "number"-typed fields. nil
means no bound on that side. Frontend uses these to constrain
inputs; backend re-validates as defense-in-depth.

connection_config.description: Driver-specific connection parameters (sensitive fields encrypted with AES-GCM)

engine_type.description: Engine type: postgres, elasticsearch, qdrant, milvus, weaviate, sqlite

index_config.description: Optional index/collection configuration (engine-specific defaults if empty)

enabled.description: Enabled toggles the volume mount for this tenant.

mount_path.description:
MountPath is the sandbox-internal path where the volume is mounted.
Default: /weknora/tenant/skills (customizable per use case).

provider.description: Provider identifies the volume backend. Currently "e2b" or "cube".

volume_id.description:
VolumeID is the provider-specific volume identifier, populated after
EnsureVolume / CreateVolume succeeds.

volume_name.description:
VolumeName is the human-readable volume name, e.g.
"weknora-tenant-<id>-skills".

volume_owner_fingerprint.description:
VolumeOwnerFingerprint = sha256(provider + APIKey + APIURL).
Used to detect when the tenant switched to a different backend or
API key, at which point the volume is no longer reachable and must
be recreated.

has_models.description: 是否已配置 WeKnoraCloud 凭证

needs_reinit.description: 是否需要重新初始化（凭证损坏）

reason.description: 需要重新初始化的原因

fetch.description: Fetch is the provider type whose API reads pages, or "local" for WeKnora's own reader.

search.description: Search is the provider type whose API runs searches.

compression_method.description: 压缩方法：none, summary, extract, rag

document_fragments.description: 文档片段数量（用于RAG压缩）

proxy_url.description: Optional per-request proxy override; normally empty — use WebSearchProviderEntity.Parameters.proxy_url. Merged at call time when set.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default provider for the workspace

parameters.description: Provider-specific parameters (API key, engine ID, etc.) stored as encrypted JSON

provider.description: Provider type: bing, google, duckduckgo, tavily

api_key.description: API key for the search provider (encrypted in DB)

base_url.description:
Base URL for self-hosted search engines (e.g. SearXNG instance URL).
Validated with utils.ValidateURLForSSRF; private hosts must be added to SSRF_WHITELIST.

engine_id.description: Google Custom Search Engine ID (only for Google provider)

extra_config.description: Provider-specific extra configuration for future extensibility

proxy_url.description:
Optional HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for outbound search requests (e.g. http://host:port); validated with utils.ValidateURLForSSRF.
Does not replace the search API endpoint; only tunnels traffic to the official APIs.

clients.description: Search and fetch readers registered for this type; nil when the type is not registered.

config_fields.description: Provider-specific non-secret configuration rendered dynamically by the frontend.

docs_url.description: URL to the provider's official website or documentation for obtaining credentials

requires_api_key.description: Whether the provider requires an API key

requires_base_url.description: Whether the provider requires a user-supplied base URL (e.g., self-hosted SearXNG instance)

requires_engine_id.description: Whether the provider requires an engine ID (e.g., Google CSE)

supports_optional_api_key.description:
Whether the provider accepts an optional API key (keyless by default, but a
key unlocks higher limits — e.g. Keenable). Mutually exclusive with RequiresAPIKey.

supports_proxy.description: Whether optional proxy_url in parameters is honored for outbound requests

auto_generate.description:
AutoGenerate disables background Wiki generation when false. Omitted means true.
Manual page APIs and Wiki retrieval remain available while Wiki is enabled.

content_instructions.description: ContentInstructions sets tone and emphasis for generated Wiki prose. Citations stay fixed.

extraction_granularity.description: ExtractionGranularity is focused, standard or exhaustive. Empty means standard.

extraction_instructions.description: ExtractionInstructions tells page extraction which concepts to keep. The output format stays fixed.

ingest_batch_size.description:
IngestBatchSize controls how many pending ops a single batch claims and
processes before scheduling a follow-up. 0 falls back to the hard-coded
default (5). Larger batches amortize per-batch setup and let more docs
share the batch-internal Map/Reduce fan-out; smaller batches spread a
KB's backlog across more concurrent batches (finer scheduling grain).

ingest_map_parallel.description:
IngestMapParallel sets the errgroup limit for the Map phase
(per-document extraction + summary + chunk citation) WITHIN one batch.
0 falls back to 10. Bound by the LLM provider's concurrency limit and
the worker's outbound HTTP pool. Remember it multiplies with the number
of concurrent batches (IngestMaxInflight).

ingest_max_inflight.description:
IngestMaxInflight caps how many ingest batches for THIS KB may run
concurrently in the shared wiki worker pool (standard/Redis mode
only). 0 falls back to the hard-coded default (4). Since Phase 3
removed the exclusive per-KB lock, one KB's backlog could otherwise
monopolize the whole pool during a bulk import and starve other KBs;
this knob trades a single KB's peak throughput for cross-KB fairness.
Set it >= the wiki pool size to effectively disable the cap.

ingest_reduce_parallel.description:
IngestReduceParallel sets the errgroup limit for the Reduce phase
(per-slug page write) WITHIN one batch. 0 falls back to 10. Bound by the
same LLM concurrency / HTTP pool considerations as the Map phase, plus
DB connection pool size. Same multiplier caveat as IngestMapParallel.

max_pages_per_ingest.description: MaxPagesPerIngest limits pages created or updated per ingest. 0 means no limit.

synthesis_model_id.description: SynthesisModelID is the model that writes Wiki pages. Empty uses summary_model_id.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id; empty means the top level.

familiar_count.description: FamiliarCount is how many returned nodes are lit up for this person.

total.description: total node count in the KB before filtering/limit

familiar.description:
Familiar is true when this page was built from a document this person
keeps citing in answers. It is a personal overlay, not a property of
the page: two people looking at the same wiki see different highlights.

aliases.description: Alternate names, abbreviations, acronyms or translated names

category_path.description:
CategoryPath is the directory breadcrumb that groups this page in the
wiki browser, e.g. ["AI", "LLM 应用", "RAG"]. Derived cache of the
folder chain identified by FolderID.

chunk_refs.description:
ChunkRefs records the specific source-document chunks this page was
built from — one UUID per cited chunk. Populated during ingest from
the chunk-citation pass; refreshed wholesale whenever the page is
re-materialized. Empty for summary pages (they are document-level
synopses and don't carry chunk-level citations). Use this when you
need to surface the underlying evidence for a wiki page, or to
retract citations when a source document is deleted.

depth.description: Depth is len(CategoryPath), cached for filtering / display.

folder_id.description:
FolderID is the single source of truth for where this page sits in the
directory tree — a reference to wiki_folders.id ("" = wiki root). The
CategoryPath / WikiPath / Depth fields below are denormalized caches
recomputed from this folder's chain on every write so list/index/search
queries don't have to join wiki_folders.

in_links.description: Slugs of pages that link TO this page (backlinks)

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge base this page belongs to

last_edit_source.description:
LastEditSource records who authored the CURRENT version: pipeline |
agent | user | revert. Empty for legacy rows (treated as pipeline).
When the version is superseded this value travels into the revision
snapshot, so each historical version keeps its own author kind.

last_editor_id.description:
LastEditorID is the user id of the caller that produced the current
version (empty for background pipeline writes).

out_links.description: Slugs of pages this page links to (outbound links)

page_type.description: Page type: summary, entity, concept, index, synthesis, comparison

parent_slug.description:
ParentSlug optionally points at the wiki page that should act as this
page's semantic parent in the directory tree. The parent may be empty
when the page is grouped only by FolderID.

slug.description:
URL-friendly slug for addressing, e.g. "entity/acme-corp", "concept/rag"
Unique within a knowledge base

sort_order.description:
SortOrder allows generated or manually edited pages to control sibling
ordering before falling back to title.
