real "the page was edited" signal.

wiki_path.description:
WikiPath is a normalized, sortable path derived from page_type,
category_path, and title. It keeps large directory listings cheap to sort.

folder_id.description: Target folder id; empty means the top level.

slug.description: Slug of the page to move.
Slug of the page to revert.

version.description: Revision to restore. Versions start at 1.

edit_source.description: Author of THIS version (same semantics as WikiPage.LastEditSource).

edited_at.description: When this version was authored (the page's updated_at while current).

version.description:
Version is the optimistic-lock guard: when > 0 the update is rejected
with a conflict if the stored version differs (someone else edited the
page since the client loaded it). 0 skips the check (legacy clients).

is_active.description: whether wiki ingestion is currently running

pending_tasks.description: number of documents waiting to be ingested

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

chunk_index.description: Index position of the chunk in the original document

chunk_type.description: Chunk 类型，用于区分不同类型的 Chunk

content_hash.description: ContentHash 存储内容的 hash 值，用于快速匹配（主要用于 FAQ）

content_revision.description: ContentRevision is incremented for every user edit or rollback.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker, supports data recovery

end_at.description: Ending character position in the original text

flags.description:
Flags 存储多个布尔状态的位标志（如推荐状态等）
默认值为 ChunkFlagRecommended (1)，表示默认可推荐

id.description: Unique identifier of the chunk, using UUID format

index_status.description:
IndexStatus reports whether the current content is reflected in the
retrieval stores: ready | processing | failed.

indirect_relation_chunks.description: 间接关系 Chunk ID，用于关联间接关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

is_enabled.description: Whether the chunk is enabled, can be used to temporarily disable certain chunks

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of the knowledge base, for quick location

knowledge_id.description: ID of the parent knowledge, associated with the Knowledge model

last_editor_id.description: LastEditorID records the actor that produced the current revision.

metadata.description: Metadata 存储 chunk 级别的扩展信息，例如 FAQ 元数据

parent_chunk_id.description: 父 Chunk ID，用于关联图片 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

relation_chunks.description: 关系 Chunk ID，用于关联关系 Chunk 和原始文本 Chunk

seq_id.description: SeqID is an auto-increment integer ID for external API usage (FAQ entries)

source_locators.description:
SourceLocators point back into the original file (page and region,
slide, sheet rows, ...) so citations can open the file at this chunk.
Empty when the parser reported no positions.

start_at.description: Starting character position in the original text

tag_id.description: Optional tag ID for categorization within a knowledge base (used for FAQ)

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID, used for multi-tenant isolation

kb_id.description: Knowledge base the documents belong to.

source_id.description: Source knowledge base ID; the assistant always copies to a new knowledge base.

display_name.description: Display name of the new copy; the upstream model identifier stays unchanged.

access_level.description: How far runs may change data without asking; default confirm

approval_timeout_minutes.description: How long a run waits for an approval before it fails, in minutes; default 1440

carry_last_result.description: Whether each per_run conversation gets the last successful answer

instruction.description:
The task, sent as the user message of each run. May name now,
last_run_at, last_success_at, run_id or automation_name inside double
curly braces to have it filled in

misfire_policy.description: What happens to runs missed while the service was down; default skip

model_id.description: Optional chat model from model.list; empty follows the assistant default

notify_on_success.description: Whether a successful run notifies the owner; failures always do

overlap_policy.description: What happens when a run is due while the previous one is still going; default skip

session_mode.description: per_run (default) starts a new conversation each run; persistent keeps one

title.description: Title of the document; defaults to the fetched one.

url.description: Page or file URL to import.

usage_instructions.description: 告诉智能体何时、如何使用该服务

generated_password.description:
GeneratedPassword is the plaintext password when the server
auto-generated one. Absent when the caller supplied the password.

name.description: Tag name, unique in this knowledge base

exclude_ids.description: Chunk seq_ids to exclude from deletion

chat_id.description: ID of chat model to use

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of knowledge base to use

rerank_id.description: ID of rerank model to use

entry_ids.description: Explicit FAQ entry seq_ids from faq.list_entries. At most 20 per call.

is_enabled.description: Whether these entries can be retrieved; omitted keeps the current state.

is_recommended.description: Whether these entries are recommended; omitted keeps the current state.

tag_id.description: Tag seq_id from knowledge_base.list_tags; 0 clears tags, omitted keeps them.

db_migration_error.description:
DBMigrationError carries the human-readable error message recorded when
the most recent startup migration attempt failed. Empty when migrations
succeeded; non-empty values let the frontend surface a troubleshooting
banner instead of silently hiding the DB version row (see issue #1319).

started_at.description: StartedAt is the server process boot time (RFC3339, UTC).

uptime_seconds.description: UptimeSeconds is seconds elapsed since process start.

strategy.description:
Strategy / TokenLimit / Languages use pointer types so the
handler can distinguish "field absent in payload" (no change)
from "field present with empty/zero value" (clear / disable).
Without that distinction, users could set strategy="auto" once
but never reset it back to legacy / unset.

embeddingModelId.description: optional when RAG indexing is disabled

multimodal.description: 多模态配置（仅模型相关；存储引擎在 storageProvider 中配置）

storageProvider.description: 存储引擎选择（"local" | "minio" | "cos"），影响文档上传与文档内图片存储，参数从全局设置读取

auto_tag_config.description: AutoTagConfig controls asynchronous association of existing tags after parsing.

chunk_count.description: Chunk count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

created_at.description: Creation time of the knowledge base

creator_id.description:
CreatorID records the user ID of whoever originally created the KB.
Used by the workspace-level RBAC middleware to let Contributors edit
their own KBs without granting them access to everyone else's.
Nullable for backward compatibility with rows created before the
RBAC migration backfilled the column to the workspace Owner.

creator_name.description:
CreatorName 是 CreatorID 对应用户的展示名（username / email 等），
仅在列表场景由 handler 批量回填，不落库；为空表示创建者无法解析（用户已删除、
CreatorID 为空的老数据等）。前端用它在卡片来源徽章上做 mine vs workspace 的二分。

default_classification.description:
DefaultClassification applies to new content without an explicit
classification (V3.0 §2.4 定密：无确认时按空间默认密级处理).

deleted_at.description: Deletion time of the knowledge base

embedding_model_id.description: ID of the embedding model. model.list returns the ids. Cannot change after the knowledge base has documents.

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt ends the space's life: project close or external NDA expiry
turns it read-only (§4.1).

faq_config.description: FAQConfig stores FAQ specific configuration such as indexing strategy

generated_profile.description:
GeneratedProfile is the machine-generated description: a gist, merged
topics, typical questions and the aggregate snapshot they came from. It
never overwrites the user-authored Description; both are shown to agents.

id.description: Unique identifier of the knowledge base

indexing_strategy.description:
IndexingStrategy controls which indexing pipelines are active for this knowledge base.
Pipelines: vector search, keyword search, wiki generation, knowledge graph extraction.

is_pinned.description:
IsPinned and PinnedAt are computed per-caller from user_kb_pins
(see migration 000050). They used to be stored on the row itself,
which made pinning a workspace-wide ordering decision gated behind
the kb-edit RBAC guard. The columns are still present in legacy
schemas for rollback safety but are no longer read or written by
the application — both fields are tagged `gorm:"-"` so GORM
ignores them on every CRUD call and the list handler stamps them
after enriching with the caller's pin set.

is_processing.description: IsProcessing indicates if there is a processing import task (for FAQ type knowledge bases)

is_temporary.description: Whether this knowledge base is temporary (ephemeral) and should be hidden from UI

knowledge_count.description: Knowledge count (not stored in database, calculated on query)

my_permission.description:
MyPermission is the caller's role on a knowledge base shared from
another workspace; GET /knowledge-bases/{id} sets it.

pinned_at.description:
PinnedAt records when the current caller pinned this knowledge
base; nil when they have not.

processing_count.description: ProcessingCount indicates the number of knowledge items being processed (for document type knowledge bases)

profile_config.description:
ProfileConfig controls automatic generation of the knowledge-base
description from per-document profiles (document knowledge bases only).

question_generation_config.description: QuestionGenerationConfig stores question generation configuration for document knowledge bases

require_review.description: RequireReview forces new content through the approval flow.

share_count.description: ShareCount indicates the number of organizations this knowledge base is shared with (not stored in database)

space_kind.description:
SpaceKind distinguishes personal/team/public/project/external-collab
spaces and drives their default policy (V3.0 §4.1). Empty means team.

storage_backend_id.description:
StorageBackendID binds this KB to one concrete storage instance. The
legacy provider field remains readable during migration only.

storage_config.description: Deprecated: legacy COS config column. Kept for backward compatibility with old data.

storage_provider_config.description: Storage provider config (new): only stores provider selection; credentials from workspace StorageEngineConfig

summary_model_id.description:
Summary model ID. model.list returns the ids. Used for summaries, and as
the default for auto-tagging and the AI description.

type.description: Type of the knowledge base: document, faq or wiki. Empty means document.

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the knowledge base

vector_store_id.description:
VectorStoreID references the VectorStore this knowledge base is bound to.
When nil, the KB falls back to the workspace's effective engines derived from
the RETRIEVE_DRIVER environment variable (env store flow).
This field is set once at creation time and must not be modified afterwards;
enforcement lives at the GORM layer (`<-:create`) plus the service-layer
KB update path, which omits this field from its update DTO.

wiki_config.description: WikiConfig stores wiki-specific configuration (only for wiki type knowledge bases)

attempt.description: Attempt is the attempt the trace describes; equals CurrentAttempt.

current_stage.description: CurrentStage is the stage running now, or the last one that ran.

last_activity_at.description: LastActivityAt is set while the parse is in flight.

stall_state.description:
StallState is types.StallStateQueued or types.StallStateStalled when an
in-flight parse has gone quiet.

kb_id.description: Knowledge base the documents belong to.

knowledge_ids.description: Documents that receive the same tags. Mutually exclusive with updates.

tag_ids.description: Tags to set on every listed document. An empty list clears them.

updates.description: Map of knowledge id to the tag ids that replace its current tags.

api_key_header.description: api_key 认证使用的请求头，默认 X-API-Key

auth_type.description: auth_type 留空表示无认证；bearer 发送 token，api_key 按 api_key_header 发送密钥

source.description:
Source is the vendor page these facts were read from, so the editor can
send an operator to the documentation for this exact model.

credentialLabels.description:
CredentialLabels rename the primary credential input for the model
types that do not take a plain API key (signed rerank APIs).

icon.description: Icon is a data: URI (image/svg+xml;base64) ready for .

appSecret.description: AppSecret 用于 LKEAP / Volcengine Rerank 等需要第二段密钥的场景（对应模型 Parameters.AppSecret）。

modelId.description:
ModelID, when set, instructs the handler to substitute any missing
secrets (APIKey, AppSecret via ExtraConfig) from the stored model
record before assembling the test client. This lets the "Test
connection" button work on existing models without making the
frontend reload — and ship — the plaintext API key. Other fields
(BaseURL, ModelName, etc.) on this request still override the
stored values, so a user can validate a new endpoint against the
existing credentials in one click.

mode.description: reuse_vectors keeps the embeddings; reparse processes the documents again.

source_kb_id.description: Knowledge base the documents are in now.

target_kb_id.description: Knowledge base to move them to.

folder_path.description: Target folder path; empty (allowed) means the knowledge base top level.

kb_id.description: Knowledge base the documents belong to.

agent_mode.description: Running mode: quick-answer is RAG; smart-reasoning calls tools, MCP and skills

kb_selection_mode.description: Knowledge bases searched: all, selected (knowledge_bases) or none

knowledge_bases.description:
Selected knowledge bases, replacing the current ones; without
kb_selection_mode it also switches the mode to selected

mcp_selection_mode.description: MCP services used: all, selected (mcp_services) or none

mcp_services.description:
Selected MCP services, replacing the current ones; without
mcp_selection_mode it also switches the mode to selected

model_id.description: Chat model the agent answers with

multi_turn_enabled.description: Whether earlier turns are kept in the conversation context

selected_skills.description:
Selected skill names, replacing the current ones; without
skills_selection_mode it also switches the mode to selected

skills_selection_mode.description: Skills used: all, selected (selected_skills) or none

web_search_enabled.description: Whether the agent may search the web

web_search_provider_id.description: Empty follows the workspace default; changing the provider does not enable search.

conflict_strategy.description: Overwrite existing content or skip conflicts.

resource_ids.description: Replaces the complete selection. Get IDs from data_source.list_resources; never infer them from names.

sync_deletions.description: Whether future syncs delete documents that were removed upstream.

sync_mode.description: Incremental sync or a full scan.

sync_schedule.description: Six-field cron including seconds, optionally prefixed with CRON_TZ=Area/City. Empty disables scheduled sync.

chunking_config.description: Chunking settings. Only the fields present are changed.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep it; an empty string clears it.

embedding_model_id.description: Embedding model. Cannot change after the knowledge base has documents.

extract_config.description: Graph extraction. Node types stay in the knowledge base editor.

faq_config.description: FAQ indexing. Only for an FAQ knowledge base.

image_caption_enabled.description: Run image captions in the default image pipeline. Set image_pipeline=default to select that pipeline.

image_ocr_enabled.description: Run OCR in the default image pipeline. At least one of captions or OCR must stay enabled.

indexing_strategy.description: Indexing pipelines. A flag left out stays as it is.

name.description: New name. Omit to keep the current one.

parser_engine.description: Engine name from knowledge_base.list_parser_engines; empty removes explicit routing for parser_file_types.

parser_file_types.description: File extensions whose parser routing should change, e.g. ["pdf", "docx"]. Other file types keep their rules.

parser_xlsx_first_row_as_header.description: Treat the first XLSX row as headers. Requires parser_file_types including xlsx and an explicit parser_engine.

profile_config.description: AI description of the knowledge base.

storage_backend_id.description: Storage instance to bind. Omit to keep the current one.

summary_model_id.description: Summary model. model.list returns the ids.

display_name.description: 新的显示名称，空字符串表示改回使用模型名

is_default.description: Whether agents without an explicit provider use this service by default.

truncated_to.description:
TruncatedTo, when set, is the original chunk count before the
response was truncated to previewMaxChunks for transport.

appSecret.description: AppSecret 用于 LKEAP / Volcengine Rerank 等需要第二段密钥的场景（对应模型 Parameters.AppSecret）。

modelId.description:
ModelID, when set, instructs the handler to substitute any missing
secrets (APIKey, AppSecret via ExtraConfig) from the stored model
record before assembling the test client. This lets the "Test
connection" button work on existing models without making the
frontend reload — and ship — the plaintext API key. Other fields
(BaseURL, ModelName, etc.) on this request still override the
stored values, so a user can validate a new endpoint against the
existing credentials in one click.

process_config.description: ProcessConfig overrides the processing options stored at upload time.

chunk_id.description: ChunkID optionally pins the reported passage.

expected_revision.description: Current content_revision from chunk.get; a stale value fails with HTTP 409.

revision.description: Historical revision number from chunk.list_revisions to restore.

internal_handler.RuntimeWorkerPool.description: Return every row in the system_settings table (system-scope, not workspace-scoped). SystemAdmin only.

active.description: live workers assigned to this pool

message.description: Message carries free-form provider detail for an executed probe.

reason.description:
Reason is a stable code explaining why a probe was skipped. It exists so
the UI can phrase the skip in the operator's language instead of echoing
a server-side sentence.

config_id.description:
ConfigID lets an edit form test stored credentials while overriding only
the fields the admin changed in the drawer.

deep.description:
Deep additionally runs a throwaway script. For remote backends this also
creates and destroys one sandbox, which is the only way to validate the
template ID, data plane, in-sandbox execution, and outbound egress. It may
consume real sandbox time, so it is opt-in.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

available.description: whether the engine can be used

avatar.description:
Avatar travels as a pointer so an omitted field can be told apart from
an explicit clear: nil keeps the stored avatar, a pointer to "" wipes
it. As a plain string the two cases were indistinguishable, so a caller
that PUT only a config silently zeroed the avatar and still got a 200.

content.description: Complete replacement content; omitted keeps the existing content.

expected_revision.description: Current content_revision from chunk.get; a stale value fails with HTTP 409.

is_enabled.description: Whether this chunk participates in retrieval; omitted keeps its state.

vlm_config.description:
VLMConfig updates the knowledge base's multimodal (vision) config.
Optional: nil means "no change", mirroring how CreateKnowledgeBase
accepts a top-level vlm_config.

description.description: New summary; omit to keep it, empty clears it.

title.description: New title; omit to keep it.

url.description: 新的服务地址（http 或 https）

usage_instructions.description: 新的使用说明，1 到 16000 个字符

assignee_id.description: AssigneeID reassigns the task (empty string clears the assignee).

resolution_note.description: ResolutionNote — required to close as done; carries the waived reason.

value.description:
Value is intentionally `any` (decoded as float64 / string / bool /
etc. by the JSON unmarshaller). Service.encodeForType normalises
these against the registry's declared type and rejects mismatches.

name.description: New name. Omit to keep the current one.

next_runs.description: The next times the trigger fires, in UTC

finding_type.description: FindingType 命中类别（可省略，默认 custom_pattern）。

name.description: Name 规则名（可省略，服务层自动命名 custom-N）。

similar_questions.description: Phrasings to add to the entry.

has_hmac_secret.description:
HasHMACSecret reports whether a signing secret is configured. The
plaintext secret is NEVER returned — clients only learn presence.

nodes.description:
Nodes is the approval chain (§6.3): 或签 / 会签 / 逐级 都由它表达。
Omit to clear the definition and fall back to the implicit single node.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor is the id of the last entry on this page, 0 when it is empty.

kb_id.description: Knowledge base the documents belong to.

failed.description: "sandbox config id: reason" for each sandbox that was not started

started.description: Sandbox config ids whose install started

sandbox_config_ids.description: Sandbox config ids to install onto: an agent's sandbox_config_id, or host on WeKnora Lite

success.description: false when any sandbox failed to start

result.description: Result is the verification conclusion (§7.2 关闭条件②).

close_conditions.description: CloseConditions 结构化关闭前置条件（v1 只读展示）。

effective_at.description: EffectiveAt / AnnounceAt / ExpiresAt 生效/公告/失效时间（可选）。

note.description: Note 创建人补充说明，冻结进 baseline。

max_classification.description: MaxClassification 本次导出允许的最高密级；省略按 internal。

scope_filter.description:
ScopeFilter 是导出范围过滤（kb_ids / 条数 / 时间窗），结构按 scope
各异，v1 不做严格 schema 校验。

watermark_text.description: WatermarkText 自定义水印；省略由服务端生成。

enabled.description: Enabled defaults to true when omitted.

model_id.description: ModelID is the models-table ID calls are routed to.

platform.description:
Platform marks the rule as platform-level (tenant 0, inherited by
every tenant). Only system administrators may set it.

scope_value.description:
ScopeValue: task key (chat/embedding/rerank/...) or classification
value (public/internal/secret/confidential).

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is the optional link expiry.

note.description: Note 审批备注（reject 时必填，服务层校验）。

expires_in_hours.description:
ExpiresInHours bounds the delegation; 0 means no expiry (must be revoked
explicitly). A finite default keeps a forgotten delegation from lasting
forever.

action.description: Action is one of the KnowledgeLifecycleAction constants.

change_note.description: ChangeNote is stored on the published version snapshot (publish action).

classification.description:
Classification / EffectiveAt / ExpiresAt / ReviewCycleDays apply to the
update_settings action.

receipt_id.description:
ReceiptID links a publish to its approval receipt (filled by the review
service; accepted here for direct administrative publishing).

replaced_by_id.description: ReplacedByID is required for the replace action.

value.description:
Value is unused by the delete endpoints. Clearing a value is a delete
rather than a write of "", so a member always has one unambiguous way to
revoke.

governance_level.description:
GovernanceLevel is the §8.2 L0–L4 maturity; the domain floor raises it
and the level can never be lowered afterwards.

relation_type.description:
RelationType is one of based_on/replaces/supplements/conflicts/
prerequisite/responsible/related.

enabled.description:
Enabled shows (true) or hides (false) the skill. Its absence leaves the
skill as it is, since a body may carry envs instead.

envs.description:
Envs is a pointer to a map because "sent an empty object" and "did not
mention envs" are different requests: the first clears what it names,
the second must leave every stored value alone.

missing_envs.description:
MissingEnvs names the required environment variables with no
workspace value yet; the skill cannot run until they are set.

served.description:
Served is the previous version that keeps running while this install
is in flight or after it failed.

source.description:
Source is exactly one of: "@owner/slug" or a slash-free slug (ClawHub),
a github.com / gitlab.com / skills.sh / clawhub / skillhub page URL, a
ClawHub skills-sh catalog page or "skills-sh:owner/repo/slug" locator, or
a direct zip/SKILL.md URL. Bare "owner/slug" is rejected: it is both a
ClawHub id and a GitHub repo. The fetch carries no credential.

choices.description: Choices maps question_id → selected option index.

kb_id.description: KBID sizes the field-migration tasks (affected entry count).

last_active_tenant_id.description:
LastActiveTenantID lets clients persist "after a fresh login,
drop me back into this workspace" across devices. The SPA sends
this after every tenant switch; POST /auth/switch-tenant records
the same preference server-side. Send a positive workspace id to
set / replace, or 0 to clear. Membership is validated at next
login, not here. Nil = field omitted from the PATCH and stays
untouched.

description.description: New description, at most 512 characters; empty clears it. Omission preserves it.

name.description: New workspace name; cannot be blank, at most 128 characters.

agent_enabled.description: Whether agent mode is enabled for this request

agent_id.description: Selected custom agent ID (backend resolves shared agent and its workspace from share relation)

agent_source_tenant_id.description: Optional disambiguator; backend still verifies the share relation

assistant_access.description:
AssistantAccess is the WeKnora assistant access level: read_only,
confirm or auto_write. The workspace ceiling caps it; other agents
ignore it.

disable_title.description: Whether to disable auto title generation

knowledge_base_ids.description: Selected knowledge base ID for this request

knowledge_ids.description: Selected knowledge ID for this request

page_context.description: PageContext is the WeKnora page the user has open (agent mode only).

query.description: Query text; may be empty only when an image or file is attached

question_origin.description: QuestionOrigin is the knowledge source of a picked suggested question.

reasoning_effort.description: ReasoningEffort overrides thinking for this request; empty inherits the agent configuration.

summary_model_id.description: Optional summary model ID for this request (overrides session default)

web_search_enabled.description: Whether web search is enabled for this request

project_dir.description:
ProjectDir is an optional Lite host-sandbox binding. When set it must
be an absolute path already present in the user-approved ProjectDirs
list. Empty means the session gets an auto-allocated workspace.

message_id.description:
MessageID is the message to branch at. A user message copies history
strictly before it (the client prefills that question). An assistant
message copies history through that answer so the branch continues after it.

title.description: Title is optional. Empty falls back to the source title plus a suffix.

messages.description: Messages to use as context for title generation

url.description: serving URL after saving to storage

kb_id.description: Parent knowledge base for file/tag mentions

service_id.description: Parent MCP service for MCP tool mentions

message_id.description:
MessageID is the message to rewind to. A user message deletes itself and
everything after (the client prefills that question). An assistant
message keeps itself and deletes everything after.

knowledge_base_id.description: KnowledgeBaseID is a single KB (for backward compatibility).

knowledge_base_ids.description: KnowledgeBaseIDs lists the KBs to search (multi-KB support).

knowledge_ids.description: KnowledgeIDs narrows the search to specific knowledge (file) IDs.

mentioned_items.description: MentionedItems carries optional scoped tag mentions.

parent_slot_aggregation.description:
ParentSlotAggregation gives one top-k slot to all hits sharing a parent
chunk, returning the parent body with the matched child ids.

query.description:
Query is the text query. It is required unless QueryImage is set: an
image-only request searches by visual similarity.

query_image.description:
QueryImage is a base64 (optionally a data URI) image used as the vector
query instead of Query text. When both are set the image drives vector
recall and the text drives keyword recall and rerank.

tag_ids.description: TagIDs filters within a single KB.

vector_threshold.description: Optional overrides of the tenant retrieval config. Omitted fields keep it.

delivery.description: Delivery is "after" (default) or "inject". See the constants above.

expected_assistant_message_id.description:
Optional for older clients. New clients pin delivery to the run they see
and supply a stable ID so a consume event may precede the HTTP response.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key 认证：空间 Key 固定访问所属空间；平台 Key 调用空间接口时需同时传 X-Tenant-ID
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key

Bearer.description: 用户登录认证：输入 Bearer {token} 格式的 JWT 令牌
Bearer.name: Authorization
